madeleineanbar.specialties: trauma, perinatal, couples, family violence, Gottman

laurendavidson.name: Lauren Davidson
laurendavidson.title: Mental Health Counsellor & Social Worker
laurendavidson.description: Lauren is a mental health counsellor and social worker with more than 20 years' experience working with individuals and families across complex and high-risk contexts. She is highly skilled in client-inclusive practice, family violence, trauma-informed practice and therapeutic family work, and is a trained family therapist.
laurendavidson.specialties: trauma-informed practice, family violence, family therapy, postpartum

alexandrabarry.name: Alex Barry
alexandrabarry.title: Psychologist
alexandrabarry.description: Alex has experience working with young and older adults who are seeking support for the impacts of sexual trauma, abuse and neglect, family and intimate partner violence, relationship and intimacy issues. Alex's therapeutic approach is integrative, drawing on a range of interventions including EMDR, cognitive behavioural therapy, schema therapy, internal family systems, mindfulness and somatic based practice. Alex practices from a place that is deeply person-centred, neuro-affirming, sex positive, and LGBTQIA+ inclusive.
alexandrabarry.specialties: Complex Trauma, PTSD, Sexual Abuse/Assault, Sexual Problems, Sexuality & Gender, EMDR, Schema Therapy, IFS

allisonconyer.name: Allison Conyer
allisonconyer.title: Psychologist
allisonconyer.description: Allison has counselled individuals managing anxiety, depression, trauma, abuse, low self-esteem, body issues, perfectionism and more. Allison employs an integrative approach drawing upon cognitive behaviour therapy, acceptance and commitment therapy, schema therapy, brief psychodynamic psychotherapy, mindfulness, trauma-informed recovery-based practice, and play therapy. Also works with couples and families.
allisonconyer.specialties: PTSD, trauma, anxiety, eating disorders, Schema Therapy, Sex Therapy, Couples Therapy

amybortz.name: Amy Bortz
amybortz.title: Clinical Psychologist
amybortz.description: Amy (she/her) is a compassionate and LGBTQIAP+ friendly clinician who works with clients aged 16+. Amy tends to utilise skills and techniques from various treatment modalities, including Schema Therapy, ACT, CBT, Mindfulness, DBT and Compassion-Focused Therapy. Clinical interests include gender dysphoria, LGBTQIA+ and non-monogamy/polyamory.
amybortz.specialties: LGBTQIA+, Gender Dysphoria, Non-Monogamy/Polyamory, Eating Disorders, Schema Therapy

belindapacella.name: Belinda Pacella
belindapacella.title: Clinical Psychologist, Board-Approved Supervisor
belindapacella.description: Belinda values building an authentic therapeutic relationship where people feel safe to explore parts of their inner world in a non-judgemental and empathic space. She adopts an integrative approach mainly informed by relational and emotion-focussed frameworks, particularly Intensive Short Term Dynamic Psychotherapy (ISTDP). Clinical interests include trauma and adjustment, complex trauma and intergenerational trauma.
belindapacella.specialties: Complex trauma, Intergenerational trauma, Anxiety, Depression, ISTDP

brigidblanckenberg.name: Brigid Blanckenberg
brigidblanckenberg.title: Clinical Psychologist
brigidblanckenberg.description: Brigid is an accredited EMDR therapist and Internal Family Systems therapist (Level 1), and she also draws upon Schema Therapy, CBT and ACT. She has experience supporting adults and adolescents with anxiety, mood difficulties, stress, PTSD, complex trauma, relationship issues, identity and body image. She also has a strong commitment to working inclusively with members of the LGBTIQ+ community.
brigidblanckenberg.specialties: PTSD, Trauma, LGBTQIA+ Affirmative Therapy, EMDR, IFS / Parts Work, Schema Therapy

chiarakilley.name: Chiara Killey
chiarakilley.title: Clinical Psychologist
chiarakilley.description: Chiara is a neurodivergent Clinical Psychologist who practices under the neuro-affirming paradigm and sees adults for therapy and autism/ADHD assessment. She uses a tailored approach incorporating CBT, ACT, DBT, interpersonal therapy, narrative therapy, schema therapy and other evidence-based modalities. She is a neurodiversity advocate and proudly supports individuals of all genders and sexual orientations.
chiarakilley.specialties: Autism and ADHD assessment, LGBTIQA+, Schema Therapy, Depression, Anxiety

christopherdeftereos.name: Dr Christine Deftereos
christopherdeftereos.title: Clinical Psychotherapist, Psychoanalyst & Accredited Mental Health Social Worker
christopherdeftereos.description: Christine is a Clinical Psychotherapist, Psychoanalyst & Accredited Mental Health Social Worker with specialized accreditations in Complex Trauma, Acute Stress, Post Traumatic Stress Disorders, Intergenerational Trauma, and EMDR. She has worked with individuals who have survived sexual assault, childhood abuse and neglect, family and domestic violence, dissociative states and disorders, substance misuse and disordered eating.
christopherdeftereos.specialties: Complex Trauma, PTSD, Intergenerational Trauma, EMDR, Dissociative disorders, Sexual assault

ananlieu.name: An An Lieu
ananlieu.title: Couples+ Therapist / Counsellor
ananlieu.description: A therapist who works with couples+ navigating relationship challenges, life transitions, trauma, grief, and emotional expression. Special interest in communication, infidelity, intimacy, reconnecting (intimacy and sex), and identity. Welcomes people from LGBTQIA+ communities, diverse cultural backgrounds, and all relationship structures. Can provide sessions in Mandarin.
ananlieu.specialties: couples therapy, trauma, intimacy and sex, infidelity, identity, EFT, Gottman Method, IFS, somatic therapy, Mandarin

azulrosenstein.name: Azul Rosenstein
azulrosenstein.title: Couples+ Therapist / Clinical Psychologist
azulrosenstein.description: Azul is a dedicated clinical psychologist committed to empowering clients on their personal journeys. She supports individuals and couples in setting meaningful goals and building resilience, believing everyone has the inner strength to navigate life’s challenges. Whether you're facing trauma, relationship difficulties, self-esteem issues, or mood-related challenges and more, Azul offers compassionate, expert support.
azulrosenstein.specialties: couples therapy, schema therapy, Gottman Method, EMDR, trauma, self-esteem, social anxiety, Spanish

melanieschuijers.name: Dr Melanie Schuijers
melanieschuijers.title: Couples+ Therapist / Clinical Psychologist, Founder
melanieschuijers.description: Registered clinical psychologist and founder of Luma Room; member of the Society of Australian Sexologists. 'This is a LGBTQIA+ friendly space ... All relationship structures are also welcome.' Relational and attachment-based lens; experience including complex relational trauma group programs. Supports couples+ to explore intimacy more deeply and navigate non-monogamy. Currently unavailable (waitlist).
melanieschuijers.specialties: couples therapy, attachment, intimacy, non-monogamy, relational trauma, intensive couples therapy

finnnugent.name: Finn Nugent
finnnugent.title: Couples+ Therapist / Family Therapist / Social Worker
finnnugent.description: Masters-qualified Social Worker with post-graduate qualifications in Family and Relationship Therapy. 'I am an LGBTQIA+ ally and welcome people in all relationship structures.' Works with couples+ navigating sexual issues, betrayals, polyamory and non-monogamy; informed by trauma-work, Internal Family Systems, polyvagal theory. Individual work on identity, sexuality, depression and anxiety.
finnnugent.specialties: couples therapy, family therapy, sexual issues, polyamory, non-monogamy, IFS, trauma, sexuality, chosen family

genevievepapavasiliou.name: Genevieve Papavasiliou
genevievepapavasiliou.title: Couples+ Therapist / Psychologist (clinical registrar)
genevievepapavasiliou.description: Registered psychologist and clinical registrar working with couples and relationship systems on conflict, betrayal and infidelity, intimacy and connection. Welcomes people from LGBTQIA+ communities, diverse cultural backgrounds, and all relationship structures. Integrates the Gottman Method with CBT, ACT, Schema Therapy and CAT.
genevievepapavasiliou.specialties: couples therapy, Gottman Method, schema therapy, ACT, CBT, CAT, intimacy, infidelity

leahvincent.name: Leah Vincent
leahvincent.title: Couples+ Therapist / Counselling Psychologist
leahvincent.description: Counselling psychologist practising for 20 years. 'I've had significant experience working with trauma including family violence and sexual assault.' Graduate diploma thesis centred around sex and gender when coping with relationship stress; previously program manager at Star Health incl. sex worker programs; worked at CASA. Narrative therapy, ACT and CBT. Currently unavailable (waitlist); Wednesday evenings.
leahvincent.specialties: couples therapy, trauma, family violence, sexual assault, narrative therapy, ACT, CBT

mykahderose.name: Mykah DeRose
mykahderose.title: Couples+ Therapist / Clinical Psychotherapist / Counsellor
mykahderose.description: Psychotherapist bringing a relational, systemic, and integrative approach to connection, communication, sex, intimacy, and conflict. Collaborative and trauma-informed. Works with heterosexual and cisgender couples, LGBTQIA+ communities, and people in consensually non-monogamous and polyamorous relationships. Areas include LGBTQIA+ affirmative practice, addiction, identity & life transitions; neuro-affirming. Saturday daytime.
mykahderose.specialties: couples therapy, LGBTQIA+ affirmative practice, sex and intimacy, consensual non-monogamy, polyamory, trauma-informed, addiction, identity

sarahdowse.name: Sarah Dowse
sarahdowse.title: Couples+ Therapist / Sexologist / Counsellor
sarahdowse.description: Qualified sexologist and sex and relationship counsellor (Master of Sexology). Helps people develop healthier relationships with themselves, their sexuality, and others; conversations around sex, intimacy, and relationships free from shame. Welcomes people from all backgrounds, identities, sexualities, and relationship structures. Supports desire discrepancies, sexual connection and pleasure.
sarahdowse.specialties: sexology, sex therapy, sexuality, intimacy, desire discrepancy, couples therapy

claretuttleby.name: Clare Tuttleby
claretuttleby.title: Psychologist
claretuttleby.description: Clare's approach integrates evidence-based therapeutic approaches, including Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), schema-informed techniques, and mindfulness-based practices. She works with anxiety, mood-related concerns, perinatal mental health, grief and loss related to infertility and reproductive health treatments, pelvic and chronic health conditions.
claretuttleby.specialties: Schema Informed Therapy, ACT, Perinatal, Infertility, Burnout

maddiebrygel.name: Dr Maddie Brygel
maddiebrygel.title: Psychologist & Clinical Psychology Registrar
maddiebrygel.description: I am a Melbourne-based psychologist, with a doctorate in both clinical and forensic psychology. I work with people experiencing a range of emotional, psychological and life challenges, including mood difficulties, relationship concerns, grief and addiction. Clinical interests include trauma and PTSD; modalities include Schema Therapy, CBT, ACT and DBT.
maddiebrygel.specialties: Trauma and PTSD, Schema Therapy, Health professionals, Grief, Addictive behaviours

elizabethwhite.name: Elizabeth White
elizabethwhite.title: Clinical Psychologist
elizabethwhite.description: Working days: Wednesdays and Thursdays in Prahran. Trained in experiential and relational psychotherapies including ISTDP and ANZAP's Conversational Model, plus ACT and CBT. Particular interest in chronic depression and physical symptoms related to emotional stress; clinical interests include complex trauma.
elizabethwhite.specialties: Complex Trauma, Chronic Depression, Grief and Loss, ISTDP

joshuakugel.name: Dr Joshua Kugel
joshuakugel.title: Psychologist
joshuakugel.description: Josh offers an environment where clients feel deeply heard and accepted; where it becomes possible to reconnect with parts of themselves that may have long been forgotten or buried. Josh has worked in both public and private sectors, and has experience with trauma, neurodiversity, depression, anxiety, OCD, grief and loss, perfectionism, and personality disorders.
joshuakugel.specialties: Trauma, Existential concerns, Psychedelic integration, OCD, Depression

karenpereira-york.name: Karen Pereira-York
karenpereira-york.title: Clinical Psychologist
karenpereira-york.description: Karen is a clinical psychologist with over 30 years of experience who works from a psychodynamic understanding of the person. She works with unpacking trauma, managing anxiety, or understanding the intricacies of relationships, and has worked extensively with sexual abuse trauma. She often uses EMDR to address past wounds, particularly those shaped by relational and complex trauma.
karenpereira-york.specialties: Complex trauma, Sexual abuse trauma, EMDR, Grief and loss, Migration, Perinatal

kiiragavralas.name: Kiira Gavralas
kiiragavralas.title: Clinical Psychologist
kiiragavralas.description: My work is predominantly informed by psychodynamic, relational, and emotion-focused frameworks, mostly drawing from Intensive Short-Term Dynamic Psychotherapy and models grounded in attachment theory. This way of working can be helpful for emotional difficulties including depressive symptoms, anxiety symptoms, trauma symptoms, grief and loss, emotion regulation difficulties and relationship difficulties. Particular interest in the transition to parenthood.
kiiragavralas.specialties: Trauma, Perinatal / transition to parenthood, ISTDP, Attachment

kristadecastella.name: Dr Krista De Castella
kristadecastella.title: Clinical Psychologist
kristadecastella.description: I'm a clinical psychologist and psychedelic-assisted therapist (Wild Mind and MAPS trained), and part of the Clinical Psychedelic Lab at Monash University, where I've worked with MDMA-Assisted Psychotherapy for PTSD. My approach is grounded in Internal Family Systems (IFS-trained) and informed by psychodynamic, humanistic, and attachment-based frameworks. Clinical interests include LGBTQIA+, non-monogamy/polyamory, sexual problems and sexuality & gender.
kristadecastella.specialties: LGBTQIA+, Sexuality & Gender, Sexual Problems, Non-Monogamy/Polyamory, PTSD, IFS, Psychedelic integration, Autism

nicholaskleeman.name: Nick Kleeman
nicholaskleeman.title: Clinical Psychologist
nicholaskleeman.description: Nick practices using ACT, solution focused therapy, mindfulness approaches and CBT, and uses a trauma-informed approach across all his therapeutic work. Nick provides a safe and inclusive therapy space for people of all backgrounds and has experience working with people from LGBTIQ+ and CALD communities. Modalities include Parts Work Therapy.
nicholaskleeman.specialties: LGBTQIA+, ADHD, Addiction, Parts Work, Trauma-informed, Anxiety, Depression

niloodanaei.name: Niloo Danaei
niloodanaei.title: Clinical Psychologist & qualified Social Worker
niloodanaei.description: I am particularly passionate about supporting individuals affected by traumatic experiences, using a trauma-informed lens to guide their healing journey. I'm a trauma-informed Psychologist and a Level 1 IFS trained therapist. Clinical interests include psychological trauma (intergenerational, complex trauma), gender and sexuality, sexual problems; LGBTQAI+ ally and neurodivergence affirming. Languages: Farsi, Dari.
niloodanaei.specialties: Complex trauma, Intergenerational trauma, Gender and sexuality, Sexual problems, LGBTQIA+ ally, IFS, Farsi, Dari

petesteele.name: Pete Steele
petesteele.title: Clinical Psychologist
petesteele.description: Working days: Tuesdays & Wednesdays 8am to 2pm (Prahran). Pete has experience treating anxiety, depression, trauma-related difficulties, body-image concerns, OCD and more. Pete strives to provide a safe and inclusive therapeutic space for people of all backgrounds and has significant experience working with people from LGBTIQ+ and CALD communities, and uses a trauma-informed approach across all his therapeutic work.
petesteele.specialties: PTSD, Trauma, Childhood abuse, LGBTIQ+, OCD, CBT, ACT

poornaselvaraja.name: Poorna Selvaraja
poornaselvaraja.title: Clinical Psychologist
poornaselvaraja.description: Poorna has developed expertise in working with people experiencing anxiety, depression, mood and personality disorders, relationship difficulties, trauma, complex trauma (gender-based violence, migrant, asylum seeker and refugee contexts), life stressors and cultural adjustment. She is trained in several therapeutic approaches including CBT, Schema Therapy and Psychodynamic Therapy.
poornaselvaraja.specialties: Complex trauma, Refugee and migrant trauma, Schema Therapy, Personality disorders

rebekahbarson.name: Rebekah Barson
rebekahbarson.title: Individual and Couples Counsellor (Mental Health Social Worker)
rebekahbarson.description: Rebekah is a clinical Mental Health Social Worker with additional training in Psychotherapy, Relationship Counselling and ACT, who works with both individuals and couples. Clinical interests include past trauma and difficult early life events, relationship issues and perinatal mental health.
rebekahbarson.specialties: Past trauma, Couples, Perinatal, ACT, EFT

rickiknoetze.name: Ricki Knoetze
rickiknoetze.title: Registered Psychologist
rickiknoetze.description: Ricki draws from evidence-based therapies including CBT, ACT and psychodynamic approaches. She has worked with adolescents and adults experiencing anxiety, depression, trauma, OCD, ADHD, grief and interpersonal issues. Clinical interests include PTSD and trauma; modalities include Internal Family Systems.

rubybouhadana.name: Ruby Bouhadana
rubybouhadana.title: Clinical Psychologist
rubybouhadana.description: I work with adults navigating anxiety, depression, complex trauma, emotional overwhelm and dysregulation, relationship difficulties, self-esteem difficulties, and burnout. My work is informed by Internal Family Systems (IFS Therapist Level 1), CBT, ACT, Schema Therapy, and mindfulness-based practices. I welcome all parts of a person's experience without judgment.
rubybouhadana.specialties: Complex trauma, Schema Therapy, IFS, Emotion regulation, Anxiety

katherineebsworth.name: Kate Ebsworth
katherineebsworth.title: Principal Clinical Psychologist
katherineebsworth.description: Areas: depression, anxiety, trauma, relationships, work problems, pregnancy and parenting, adjustment, health and sexuality. I provide cognitive behaviour therapy (CBT), Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR), Schema Therapy, Mindfulness, Interpersonal Neurobiology and Couples Therapy. I work in Heidelberg on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Fridays.
katherineebsworth.specialties: trauma, EMDR, schema therapy, sexuality, couples, perinatal

abigaildeodatus.name: Abigail Deodatus
abigaildeodatus.title: Psychologist - Clinical Psychology Registrar
abigaildeodatus.description: Anxiety, depression, development issues, trauma, relationships, work problems, adjustment, the Expat experience, stress management, neurodivergence/ADHD, bullying. I tend to curate evidence-based therapy such as CBT, ACT, and Schema Therapy to best suit each person's goals and needs.
abigaildeodatus.specialties: trauma, schema therapy, expat adjustment, ADHD

lauracapitanio.name: Dr Laura Capitanio
lauracapitanio.title: Clinical Psychologist
lauracapitanio.description: Depression, anxiety and trauma, sleep, parenting, childhood emotional and behavioural difficulties, ADHD, and adjustment to change. Draws on CBT, Schema Therapy, ACT and Positive Psychology. Works via Telehealth on Mondays, in Kew Tuesday-Thursday and in Heidelberg on Saturdays.
lauracapitanio.specialties: trauma, schema therapy, sleep, parenting, children

martinelynch.name: Martine Lynch
martinelynch.title: Psychologist - Clinical Psychology Registrar
martinelynch.description: I work with people presenting with issues including trauma, anxiety, parenting, childhood and adolescent emotional and behavioural difficulties, developmental trauma, body image, family violence, and coping with adjustment to life transitions. Works with children (5+), adolescents and adults.
martinelynch.specialties: trauma, developmental trauma, family violence, parenting

laurenmaruff.name: Lauren Maruff
laurenmaruff.title: Psychologist - Clinical Psychology Registrar
laurenmaruff.description: Depression, anxiety, trauma, grief and loss, adjustment and life transitions, neurodiversity, interpersonal relationships, sleep, women's health (incl fertility, PCOS, endometriosis, menopause). Works primarily with children (7+) and adults (17-35).

taniamiles.name: Dr Tania Miles
taniamiles.title: Clinical Psychologist
taniamiles.description: Mood disorders, ASD, ADHD, OCD, relationship problems, grief, body image and eating disturbances, trauma, personality disturbance, parenting difficulties. I utilise CBT, Psychodynamic, Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR), ACT with Mindfulness, systems, and am constantly learning and integrating.
taniamiles.specialties: trauma, EMDR, eating disorders, OCD, personality

lauramurfett.name: Laura Murfett
lauramurfett.title: Clinical Psychologist
lauramurfett.description: Anxiety, depression, stress, adjustment to change, trauma, parenting and childhood behavioural difficulties, new parenting adjustment, antenatal and birth anxiety; particular interest in disability and neurodivergence. Uses CBT, ACT and Schema Therapy.
lauramurfett.specialties: trauma, schema therapy, perinatal, disability, neurodivergence

elizabethsolum.name: Elizabeth Solum
elizabethsolum.title: Clinical Psychologist
elizabethsolum.description: Works with adolescents, adults, older adults, and those from the LGBTQIA+ community. Trauma (including complex trauma), grief and loss, depression, anxiety disorders and adjustment difficulties, Neurodivergence (ASD/ADHD). Key therapeutic techniques include Schema Therapy, ACT, EMDR, Narrative Therapy and CBT. (Elementa has Heidelberg and Kew clinics; bio does not specify which.)
elizabethsolum.specialties: LGBTQIA+, complex trauma, EMDR, schema therapy, neurodivergence

andreaquah.name: Dr Andrea Quah
andreaquah.title: Clinical Psychologist
andreaquah.description: Depression, anxiety and trauma, parenting, childhood emotional and behavioural difficulties, ADHD, grief and loss, and adjustment to change in life circumstances. (Elementa has Heidelberg and Kew clinics; bio does not specify which.)
andreaquah.specialties: trauma, children and adolescents, parenting, grief

galithasen.name: Dr Galit Hasen
galithasen.title: Clinical Psychologist
galithasen.description: Anxiety, depression, relationship issues, trauma, grief and coping with adjustment to changes in life events; parenting and adjustment to the perinatal period. I work in Kew on Thursdays and via Telehealth on Wednesdays.

naomiheaps.name: Naomi Heaps
naomiheaps.title: Clinical Psychologist
naomiheaps.description: I work with people suffering from historical developmental trauma (childhood abuse, neglect, bullying, sexual abuse/assault, injuries and accidents) using evidence-based trauma treatments such as EMDR and Schema Therapy to resolve PTSD, anxiety, depression, and phobias as well as problematic relational patterns. I enjoy working with a wide range of clients, particularly neurodiverse, LGBTQIA, and culturally diverse populations.
naomiheaps.specialties: developmental trauma, PTSD, EMDR, schema therapy, LGBTQIA, neurodiverse, adolescents

arpitarapose.name: Arpita Rapose
arpitarapose.title: Clinical Psychologist
arpitarapose.description: Depression, anxiety, stress, trauma, sleep, ASD, and ADHD; life challenges including work, health conditions, personality and relationships, and abuse. arpitarapose.specialties: trauma, abuse, ADHD, body image, Hindi-speaking

cathycleary.name: Cathy Cleary
cathycleary.title: Senior Psychologist
cathycleary.description: I am a Senior Psychologist providing therapy to adults, couples and seniors at our Malvern Clinic. I provide specialised counselling to survivors of trauma, including First Nations People, Refugees, LGBTQIA+, Veterans and Law Enforcement. I integrate solution-focused therapy, psychoeducation, and evidence-based treatments such as CBT, DBT, EMDR, schema therapy, and strength-based interventions.
cathycleary.specialties: Trauma, PTSD, Complex-PTSD, Gender Transitioning Care, Gender Dysphoria, Gender Identity, LGBTQIA+, EMDR, Schema Therapy, Couples, Veterans
cathycleary.identity: Publicly identifies as: LGBTQIA+, Woman, First Nations, 45+

arthursone-waili.name: Dr Arthur Sone-Wai Li
arthursone-waili.title: Clinical Psychologist
arthursone-waili.description: I am a PhD-qualified clinical psychologist who specialises in chronic pain and mental health management. I use practical methods such as CBT, ACT, Motivational Interviewing, Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR), Positive Psychotherapy, and biofeedback. I provide counselling in English, Mandarin and Cantonese.
arthursone-waili.specialties: Childhood Trauma Focused, PTSD, Complex-PTSD, EMDR, Chronic pain, ADHD/Autism assessment, Mandarin, Cantonese

sarahlawry.name: Sarah Lawry
sarahlawry.title: Accredited Mental Health Social Worker
sarahlawry.description: A space where you feel seen, understood and safe to explore your experiences, relationships and the parts of yourself seeking connection. My approach is grounded in trauma informed and attachment-based therapy. Special interests: Complex PTSD, relationship dynamics, family violence, parental alienation.
sarahlawry.specialties: Complex PTSD, Childhood Trauma Focused, Dissociative Disorders, Family violence, EMDR, Neurodivergence

thomasrosser.name: Tom Rosser
thomasrosser.title: Psychologist
thomasrosser.description: I have experience working with a range of mental health issues such as depression, anxiety, OCD, self-confidence, PTSD, and more. I have specialised training in trauma treatment using EMDR, and training in Dialectical Behaviour Therapy (DBT) for clients with BPD.
thomasrosser.specialties: PTSD, Childhood Trauma Focused, EMDR, DBT, Gender Identity, OCD

franbeilharz.name: Dr Fran Beilharz
franbeilharz.title: Lead Clinical Psychologist
franbeilharz.description: Clinical Psychologist and experienced eating disorder clinician. Committed to providing trauma-informed, neurodiversity affirming, LGBTIQA+ inclusive and gender affirming care; enjoys working with clients who have multiple marginalised identities. AusPATH provider. Uses CBT, CBT-E, TBT-S, ACT and DBT with a weight-inclusive, non-diet approach.
franbeilharz.specialties: eating disorders, body dysmorphic disorder, body image, LGBTIQA+ inclusive, gender affirming, trauma-informed, AusPATH
franbeilharz.identity: 'Fran is a proud member of the queer community'

felicitystaedler.name: Felicity Staedler
felicitystaedler.title: Senior Psychologist
felicitystaedler.description: Registered Psychologist with over 12 years of experience. Uses CBT, ACT and Schema Therapy according to client needs; person-centred and values driven. Aligned with Health at Every Size principles, helping clients improve their relationships with their bodies, food and exercise.
felicitystaedler.specialties: schema therapy, eating disorders, ACT, CBT, body image

genevievefletcher.name: Genevieve Fletcher
genevievefletcher.title: Provisional Psychologist (Low Cost Clinic)
genevievefletcher.description: Provisional Psychologist in the Low Cost Provisional Psychology Clinic (no Medicare rebates). genevievefletcher.specialties: gender diversity, LGBTQIA+, intimacy, eating disorders, body image, CBT-i, insomnia, low cost

phoebebeveridge.name: Phoebe Beveridge
phoebebeveridge.title: Registered Psychologist
phoebebeveridge.description: Particular interest in the intersection between eating disorders and trauma, and how early relational experiences shape relationships with food, bodies, and ourselves. Works with complex trauma. Draws on Schema Therapy as her primary therapeutic approach, plus CBT-E and ACT; trauma-informed, HAES-aligned.
phoebebeveridge.specialties: schema therapy, complex trauma, eating disorders, CBT-E, ACT

rebeccabrooks.name: Rebecca Brooks
rebeccabrooks.title: Registered Psychologist
rebeccabrooks.description: Committed to providing a safe, trauma-informed, and neuro-affirming space. Works from CBT integrating DBT, Cognitive Processing Therapy and Solution-Focused Therapy, supporting trauma, grief and loss, anxiety disorders, mood disorders, and relationship difficulties.
rebeccabrooks.specialties: trauma, CPT, DBT, CBT, grief, neuro-affirming

staceyvandermeer.name: Stacey Van Der Meer
staceyvandermeer.title: Registered Psychologist / Clinical Registrar
staceyvandermeer.description: Particularly focused on providing neuro-affirming and gender-affirming care. Experienced eating disorder clinician also supporting post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), complex PTSD, mood, anxiety and OCD. Trained in SSCM, CBT-E, Schema Therapy interventions, and Cognitive Processing Therapy for PTSD and C-PTSD.
staceyvandermeer.specialties: gender-affirming, PTSD, complex PTSD, schema therapy, CPT, eating disorders, OCD, neuro-affirming

daniellesellick.name: Danielle Sellick
daniellesellick.title: Principal Psychologist (Clinical), MAPS, FCCLP
daniellesellick.description: Danielle helps adults experiencing anxiety and panic, depression, trauma, relationship, workplace and parenting concerns, grief and loss, and more. She also provides clinical supervision and consultation as an EMDRAA Accredited Consultant. Danielle uses EMDR therapy, Schema therapy, Ego State Therapy, CBT and other evidence-based therapies. Former board Director of EMDRAA.
daniellesellick.specialties: EMDR, trauma, schema therapy, ego state therapy, supervision

miriamtaouk.name: Miriam Taouk
miriamtaouk.title: Senior Psychologist
miriamtaouk.description: Miriam combines evidence-based treatments, including Cognitive Behavioural Therapy, EMDR Therapy, Ego State Therapy, and Schema Therapy, with a holistic approach. Miriam has also completed training in Deep Brain Reorienting (DBR), and additional training in working with Dissociative Identity Disorder and Sensorimotor Psychotherapy. She treats anxiety, depression, drug and alcohol abuse, grief and loss, trauma, and relationships.
miriamtaouk.specialties: EMDR, Dissociative Identity Disorder, DBR, sensorimotor psychotherapy, ego state therapy, schema therapy, trauma, eating disorders

renaevanderheyden.name: Renae Vanderheyden
renaevanderheyden.title: Psychologist
renaevanderheyden.description: Renae combines CBT, Schema Therapy, Ego State Therapy and ACT, and has completed EMDR Level 2 training. She works collaboratively with clients across a broad range of presenting issues including complex PTSD, trauma, attachment, anxiety, depression, addiction, ADHD, grief & loss, relationships and couple's therapy. She provides a supportive environment for the client to explore and understand past, complex traumas.
renaevanderheyden.specialties: complex PTSD, trauma, EMDR, schema therapy, ego state therapy, couples

vickiashton.name: Vicki Ashton
vickiashton.title: Clinical Psychologist
vickiashton.description: Vicki is a clinical psychologist with 15 years experience working with children, parents, young people and adults experiencing emotional and relational problems. She has completed EMDR Level 1 and Level 2 training.
vickiashton.specialties: EMDR, children, parents, young people, relational problems

emanshehata.name: Eman Shehata

I work with individuals and couples of any sexual orientation on a short or long term basis. As a sex therapist or sex counsellor, I work in an integrative, structured framework using a solution-focused approach combined with evidence-based strategies such as cognitive-behavioural therapy and systemic theories in the main.

julylies.title: Psychologist

Specifically, she provided specialised trauma-informed assessment and intervention to young people and families from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds. In private practice, she works with clients struggling with overcoming PTSD, mood and anxiety disorders, insomnia disorders, attachment and interpersonal difficulties, as well as life transition difficulties. July bore witness to recurring traumatic loops in the absence of rest, attunement, authenticity and self-compassion that plagues both minds and bodies.
julylies.specialties: Effects of trauma/PTSD; Stress and anxiety; Sleep disturbance; Life transition difficulties; LGBTQ

nadinegalloway.specialties: Depression, anxiety, post-traumatic stress disorder and substance use disorders, professional interests include women’s mental health, trauma-informed therapy and psychedelic integration.

I am qualified to support children and their families including adult survivors of abuse with immediate and long term effects of trauma.

My vision is for trauma-informed, body-aware practice to be embedded not just in psychotherapy, but also in staff support, supervision, and broader community and organisational settings. Estelle is a Clinical Psychotherapist with over 25 years of experience in diverse roles spanning trauma-informed psychotherapy, staff support, clinical supervision, and training. Rather than focusing solely on problem-solving, I view therapy as a space to foster self-compassion for all parts of yourself, understand how past experiences shape present patterns, and cultivate resilience for a fulfilling life. As an integrative psychotherapist, I draw on a variety of therapeutic approaches, including Attachment, Trauma, Psychodynamic, Somatic, Internal Family Systems, and Transpersonal models. I can help you with a broad range of concerns, including anxiety, depression, trauma, relationship issues, grief, and existential concerns.
kimberleykifun.specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy

ohadrein.name: Ohad Rein
ohadrein.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
ohadrein.description: Hi, I’m Ohad - a psychotherapist, counsellor, and lifelong explorer of the human experience. My approach to therapy is rooted in connection, growth, and integration, blending a wide range of therapeutic modalities with over two decades of experience in therapy, music, production, meditation, yoga, and Western and Eastern philosophy. I specialise in person-centred, trauma-informed, Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), attachment repair, existential, mindfulness, somatic, emotional and transpersonal therapies, tailoring each session to your unique needs and story.
ohadrein.specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

jacquicousins.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
jacquicousins.description: I believe a culture of care is essential to improving the health of our community. I have spent 20+ years working in the community health sector and I am qualified in mental health and counselling. My experience includes counselling youth, adults, women living with chronic illness & pain, and people living with complex health issues.
jacquicousins.specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery

katalinamontaigue.name: Katalina Montaigue
katalinamontaigue.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
katalinamontaigue.description: Life might look full, and on paper it might even look good, but something feels missing. You may feel stuck, overwhelmed, disconnected from yourself, or caught in patterns that keep repeating. But they're asking, in one way or another, "Who am I?" and "What am I doing with this life?" They're not necessarily looking for answers as much as space to explore what is actually true for them, and to reconnect with the parts of themselves that have gone quiet beneath years of adapting, coping and surviving.

louisegourley.name: Louise Gourley
louisegourley.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
louisegourley.description: Over the past 25 years I have honed my experience by embracing a wide range of counselling areas, including, but not limited to, drug and alcohol, carers, mental health, domestic violence, family and relationships, elderly and dementia, intellectual disabilities, crisis and suicide prevention, PTSD, grief and loss, career and life issues, severe mental health disorders, addictions, depression and anxiety, homelessness and sexual orientation, to name a few. The variety of people I have worked with is far ranging – from farmers to captains of industry – everyone needs support at some stage. I have trained within these areas as well as obtaining my Counselling Degree, Diploma and Clinical Supervision qualifications and continue to embrace learning and research as an ongoing opportunity to offer clients the best practice.
louisegourley.specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery

joshsasai.title: Social Worker
joshsasai.description: Hi, I'm Josh, a Registered Counsellor and an Accredited Mental Health Social Worker. I offer a range of therapeutic approaches tailored to individual needs, including EMDR Therapy, Brainspotting, Somatic Approach, Mindfulness, Focusing, Internal Family Systems, Clinical Hypnosis, Qigong, Havening Techniques, and Meridian Tapping. These methods are proven effective for stress reduction, emotion regulation, and trauma processing.

I draw from Schema Therapy, CBT, Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR), ACT, mindfulness, Motivational Interviewing, and CBT for insomnia. linetteetheredge.name: Linette Etheredge
linetteetheredge.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
linetteetheredge.description: At Release me Therapy, we offer a safe therapeutic space where individuals and those in relationships can share their story, explore their feelings, deepen self-understanding and begin healing. Linette Etheredge draws on evidence and trauma informed approaches including mindfulness, psychoeducation, Emotion Focused Therapy (EFT), Narrative Therapy, Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT) and Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) to meet your individual needs and goals. As we gently attend to any grieving or tender parts of self, you’ll be supported to foster a more compassionate and intimate relationship with yourself and in time, experience more satisfying intimate connections with others. In our practice, we welcome people from all backgrounds, abilities, sexual preference, gender identity and relationship structures while supporting adults and young people aged 12+ to feel better, make changes and live their best lives!

I have considerable experience working with the more difficult areas of trauma and sexual abuse also and offer a compassionate approach using proven techniques that will make a positive difference in your life.

violetastolevska.name: Violeta Stolevska

These therapies may be helpful for anxiety, depression, relationship difficulties, stress, trauma, grief, anger, addictions, low self-esteem or life transitions.
violetastolevska.specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery

davinastorer.name: Davina Storer
davinastorer.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
davinastorer.description: My approach to counselling is one of collaboration and I approach my work with clients in a curious and non-judgemental way. My philosophy is to provide diversity-friendly therapy in a safe and supportive environment.

susanlackner.name: Susan Lackner
susanlackner.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
susanlackner.description: Melbourne Specialist Relationship Counselling Clinic Specialist Relationship Therapists with Masters Degree in Couple Counselling and trained at Relationships Australia
susanlackner.specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery

terrythomas.name: Terry Thomas - Goodier
terrythomas.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
terrythomas.description: Terry is one of Melbourne’s leading couples counsellors in the South Eastern suburbs; specialising in relationships, couples counselling and parenting. As a therapist, she enjoys getting to know couples at a deeper level, providing truly empathetic support as she journeys with her clients through a variety of challenges they face, Providing them with real and practical tools to manage conflict, deepen their connection and strengthen friendship and intimacy. Key to the success of Terry’s work is relating to both partners with equity and empathy, helping them to repair, rebuild and connect.

suzannesharp.name: Suzanne Sharp
suzannesharp.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
suzannesharp.description: My approach is person centred which means that I listen closely to you, treat you as the expert in your life, and support you in finding new and more conscious choices. My work is informed by my mindfulness meditation practice, and my training in Emotion Focused Therapy and Art Therapy.
suzannesharp.specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery

theabaker.name: Thea Baker
theabaker.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
theabaker.description: I am a counsellor and body-based (somatic) psychotherapist with special interests in all aspects women’s health, trauma (PTSD, C-PTSD) and couples / relationship therapy. I work collaboratively with my clients to find a place of healing and recovery. Now I combine that knowledge of anatomy and physiology with my research of how trauma is stored in the body using all sorts of creative approaches to therapy.
theabaker.specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

helentelfer.name: Helen Telfer
helentelfer.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
helentelfer.description: Helen is a Clinical Counsellor. She is married and has a background in education, mentoring and community groups. Her past includes; secondary teaching, mentoring young adults/young mums, raising 4 children and living overseas.

seanguy.name: Sean Guy
seanguy.title: Principal Psychologist and AHPRA Approved Supervisor

Sean is also a Gottman Trained Relationship Counsellor. Modalities include Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR). (Living Change has clinics in Fitzroy North, Collingwood, Essendon and Bellfield.)

tamarapowell.name: Tamara Powell
tamarapowell.title: Therapist
tamarapowell.description: Tamara takes a holistic approach, recognising the complex ways intersectional and structural factors impact mental health and wellbeing. She has worked with people who experience disability, live with chronic illness, have mental health issues, who are ageing and those who are bereaved. Modalities include Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR). (Living Change has clinics in Fitzroy North, Collingwood, Essendon and Bellfield.)

amandabeattie.name: Amanda Beattie
amandabeattie.title: Accredited Mental Health Social Worker & Family Therapist
amandabeattie.description: Adults and adolescents. Integrative, client-centred approach for issues including anxiety, depression, trauma, stress, loss and relationship difficulties. Couples counselling incorporating EFT, psychodynamic and multi-generational approaches; family therapy. (Living Change has clinics in Fitzroy North, Collingwood, Essendon and Bellfield.)

timslingsby.name: Tim Slingsby
timslingsby.title: Registered Psychologist
timslingsby.description: Tim draws from Interpersonal Therapy, Attachment Therapy, CBT, ACT and Internal Family Systems Therapy, and is an accredited meditation teacher. Working from a compassionate, trauma informed angle, Tim sees that we often develop behaviours and beliefs as a way of protecting ourselves from stress and overwhelm. (Living Change has clinics in Fitzroy North, Collingwood, Essendon and Bellfield.)

kristinaspanos.name: Kristina Spanos
kristinaspanos.title: Registered Psychologist
kristinaspanos.description: Kristina has a strong focus on trauma-informed practice, particularly in working with PTSD and trauma-related concerns. Her clinical work includes depression, anxiety, BPD, eating disorders, ADHD, and psychotic disorders, with a keen interest in women's mental health and frontline emergency workers. Funding pathways include WorkCover, EAP, NDIS, VOCAT and Medicare. (Living Change has clinics in Fitzroy North, Collingwood, Essendon and Bellfield.)
kristinaspanos.specialties: PTSD, trauma, BPD, emergency workers, VOCAT

simonedixon.name: Simone Dixon
simonedixon.title: Registered Psychologist
simonedixon.description: Simone is experienced with anxiety, depression, social anxiety, phobias, stress, trauma, relationship issues, workplace challenges, and low self-esteem. Simone also enjoys working with sexual health and women's health including support during menopause. Approaches include CBT, Schema Therapy, Mindfulness, Solution Focused Therapy and ACT. (Living Change has clinics in Fitzroy North, Collingwood, Essendon and Bellfield.)
simonedixon.specialties: trauma, schema therapy, sexual health, women's health

alexisreinheimer.name: Alexis Reinheimer
alexisreinheimer.title: Social Worker / Therapist
alexisreinheimer.description: She provides a person-centred, trauma-informed and nonjudgmental space for young people and adults. Alexis greatly values diversity, offering a neurodiversity-affirming approach that is gender and sexuality-affirming and culturally sensitive. (Living Change has clinics in Fitzroy North, Collingwood, Essendon and Bellfield.)

julianschokman.name: Julian Schokman
julianschokman.title: Therapist
julianschokman.description: Julian has extensive experience working with people with trauma, grief, addictions and difficulty with relationships, providing safety and encouragement to change patterns and heal wounds. Modalities include Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR). (Living Change has clinics in Fitzroy North, Collingwood, Essendon and Bellfield.)

jennvuong.name: Jenn Vuong
jennvuong.title: Holistic Counsellor
jennvuong.description: Drawing largely from Psychodynamic or Jungian and humanistic therapies, Jenn has a special interest in treating relationship or attachment issues, developmental or complex trauma, lack of meaning, existential concerns, spiritual crisis, shadow work and dream-work. (Living Change has clinics in Fitzroy North, Collingwood, Essendon and Bellfield.)
jennvuong.specialties: complex trauma, developmental trauma, Jungian, attachment

sophiabilbrough.name: Sophia Bilbrough
sophiabilbrough.title: Accredited Mental Health Social Worker
sophiabilbrough.description: Sophia has many years' experience working with diverse communities including LGBTQI+, Rainbow Mob, and refugee background Australians. Her work has focused on addressing racism and gendered inequity; she welcomes exploration of dreams, poetry and drawings during sessions. Graduate Certificate in Gestalt. (Living Change has clinics in Fitzroy North, Collingwood, Essendon and Bellfield.)
sophiabilbrough.specialties: LGBTQI+, Rainbow Mob, refugee background, Gestalt

karladubaniewicz.name: Karla Dubaniewicz
karladubaniewicz.title: Registered Psychologist, Clinical Psychology Registrar
karladubaniewicz.description: Prior to becoming a psychologist, she spent more than 15 years supporting children, adolescents, adults, and families experiencing trauma, family violence, sexual abuse, and other complex life challenges. She works with adolescents and adults experiencing anxiety, depression, trauma, and the impacts of family violence and abuse. (Living Change has clinics in Fitzroy North, Collingwood, Essendon and Bellfield.)
karladubaniewicz.specialties: trauma, sexual abuse, family violence, neurodivergent

jenniferparker.name: Jen Parker
jenniferparker.title: Clinical Hypnotherapist & Strategic Psychotherapist
jenniferparker.description: Jen is a qualified Clinical Hypnotherapist and Strategic Psychotherapist who specialises in anxiety, low self-esteem, trauma, and behavioural change. She sees behaviours not as dysfunction but as protective patterns formed over time. (Living Change has clinics in Fitzroy North, Collingwood, Essendon and Bellfield.)

diannewepa-belz.name: Dianne Wepa-Belz

robbyfullerton.description: Works with adults and couples. 'I provide LGBTQIA+ affirming care and aim to create a space where diverse identities are respected, understood and welcomed.' Integrative, over 15 years experience; trauma among listed areas. Mon-Fri.

suzanneherrity.name: Suzanne Herrity
suzanneherrity.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
suzanneherrity.description: Suzanne offers Somatic Psychotherapy, Internal Family Systems (IFS), Somatic IFS, Advanced Integrative Therapy (AIT), and Person-Centred Psychotherapy in the Dandenong Ranges near Melbourne, Victoria, and online via Telehealth. Suzanne works with adults navigating a wide range of experiences, including anxiety, depression, trauma and complex trauma (CPTSD), grief and loss, relationship and communication difficulties, major life transitions, self-esteem challenges, work-related stress, suicidal ideation, self-harm, eating distress, addiction, minority and migrant stress, and the impacts of abuse and adverse life experiences. Her work is particularly informed by an appreciation of how trauma, stress, and life experiences can be held within both the body and the nervous system. Whether you are seeking support for a specific challenge or are drawn to a deeper process of self-exploration and healing, Suzanne aims to offer a warm, grounded, and non-judgemental space where all parts of your experience are welcome.
suzanneherrity.specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy

If you are experiencing a difficulty in your life, relationships or have a previous trauma that is preventing you living the life you want to live then please reach out. A special part of my practice is dedicated to the emotional regulation aspects of ADHD by integrating body (or soma) mind and the nervous system to improve executive function.
christophersavides.specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

melissathompsonccmh.description: I am mental health clinician/ psychotherapist with more than a decade of experience helping people with challenges such as anxiety, depression, trauma, grief, substance abuse, anger management, etc.. I also specialize in working with competitors, performers and public speakers in building confidence and mental focus. I've done extensive work with adolescents as well as LGBTQIA+, couples and families.

tamaracaswell.name: Tamara Caswell
tamaracaswell.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
tamaracaswell.description: As we grow and change in life we might find ourselves faced with many different challenges, sometimes due to family history, social and cultural conditioning, religious beliefs, and gender-based beliefs, roles, and biases. We might realise that our sexual identity and preferences might be different from what we were taught to believe and as a result, we struggle within ourselves to accept who we are and are unable to live authentically. I work with individuals and couples to navigate the unique challenges faced by those wanting to explore different relationship styles other than the standard heterosexual monogamous relationship, such as Kink, BDSM, swinging, consensual nonmonogamy, or polyamory, especially those in mixed-orientation and queer relationships. I am a non-judgemental, accepting, safe, person-centered trauma-informed therapist who is there to support you through those challenging times that you might be facing either alone or as a couple.
tamaracaswell.specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery

I say this as not only a trained therapist but a person with over ten years of personal development experience: there's more in you.

taniaciotti.description: Tania is credentialled as an Accredited Mental Health Social Worker, (AASW) Accredited Social Worker (AASW), Registered Counsellor (PACFA), and Accredited & Certified Supervisor (PACFA, AAOS), whose extensive professional experience, 30+ years, as a bilingual-bicultural practitioner, spans the breadth of Social Work fields of practice, private practice and tertiary education. Tania draws from a critically-reflective and person-centered framework, her practice experience includes: counselling, complex case-management, research, project work, casework, therapeutic group-work, supervision, community development, and consultancy across a breadth of scopes of practice: child & family, aged care & older persons, disability, carers, palliative care, mental health & wellbeing, bereavement, death & dying, chronic illness, EOL, family violence, settlement and migration, grief & loss, and trauma across the lifespan. If you have any concerns feel free to call or email

guidestarpsychology.description: We provide psychology and assessment services for children, adolescents and adults. We provide quality, evidence-informed services and are a registered NDIS Provider. Our services are neuro-affirming and we are Rainbow Tick accredited and work with LGBTIQA+ people and communities. Telehealth is available.

bcmpsychologymelbourne.name: BCM Psychology Melbourne
bcmpsychologymelbourne.title: Psychology practice
bcmpsychologymelbourne.description: I work with people of all ages, primarily using ACT, DBT and Schema Therapy, but I am also skilled in other approaches such as CBT and CFT, depending on your needs or preferences. In our sessions, I will help you gain insight into how past experiences affect your present life and guide you in understanding and expressing your emotions more comfortably. I also provide assessments, specifically for Autism and ADHD, to support those who wish to gain further understanding about themselves.

liminalclinic.name: Liminal Clinic
liminalclinic.title: Psychology practice
liminalclinic.description: At The Liminal Clinic, you step into a welcoming space where your full story is honoured. Our trauma-informed therapists deliver gender-affirming, sexuality-inclusive care for adults navigating anxiety, trauma, and life’s thresholds. We celebrate neurodivergency, ADHD and autism, blending CBT, DBT, ACT, Schema Therapy and EMDR 2.0 with forward-thinking digital supports. We track progress online to keep momentum alive between sessions. Together we turn insight into change felt in everyday life.

anitakhalil.name: Anita Khalil
anitakhalil.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)

ameliamartinez-hillmann.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
ameliamartinez-hillmann.description: Relationship, Child, Youth, and Family Therapist with an Integrative, psychoeducational, person-centred and trauma informed approach. With over 15 years experience working with indivuduals, youth and Families in public, community and private practice settings.

eleanorroche.name: Eleanor Roche
eleanorroche.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
eleanorroche.description: As a trauma therapist and multidisciplinary artist, I work at the intersection of relational healing, psychological sciences, creativity, and cultural identity. My practice supports people navigating trauma, relationship patterns, and disconnection—from themselves, others and what gives them meaning in life; their values. I specialise in working with complex trauma, often rooted in experiences of intimate family violence, cultural rupture and developmental trauma. I use a range of evidence-based and expressive approaches including EMDR, attachment theory, creative arts therapies, reflective writing, and yogic practices. I offer a space where trauma can be safely recognised, processed and healed.

lyrahui.name: Lyra Hui
lyrahui.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
lyrahui.description: Areas listed on PACFA profile: Trauma recovery.

alisalhaochareonwong.name: Alisa Lhaochareonwong
alisalhaochareonwong.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
alisalhaochareonwong.description: Counselling and psychotherapy for adults. Specializing in 1,2 & 3generation immigrants. Online counselling and face to face in Fitzroy

fionamclauchlan.name: Fiona McLauchlan
fionamclauchlan.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
fionamclauchlan.description: Fiona provides counselling for the emotional aftermath of trauma, relationship harm, family violence, grief, life transitions, and other painful life experiences, while welcoming and respectfully holding your spiritual, faith-based worldview and values. Fiona provides a warm, grounded space to * make sense of what you’ve lived through * rebuild self-trust * strengthen boundaries, and * move forward with greater clarity and choice. When something painful, confusing or destabilising has happened, it can continue to affect * how safe you feel * how you see yourself, and * how you move through relationships, with yourself and others.
fionamclauchlan.specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy

emilbarna.name: Emil Barna
emilbarna.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
emilbarna.description: Emil is a psychotherapist, writer, and podcaster who specialises in treating addiction, anxiety, stress, the impacts of trauma. He is also passionate about helping people improve their confidence in navigating daily struggles. His research interests include post-traumatic stress, the human stress response, confidence-building, and self-awareness.
emilbarna.specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

lisarebecca.name: Lisa Rebecca
lisarebecca.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
lisarebecca.description: Family therapist and Individual Counsellor specialising in the impacts Alcohol and Other Drugs on Families and Supports.

frithluton.name: Frith Luton
frithluton.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
frithluton.description: I am a Zurich-trained Jungian psychoanalyst, for more see my website at FrithLuton.com Therapy can be both short and longterm and focuses on depth psychological dream interpretation and on bringing meaning to a person’s life through how their symbolic life resonates with reviewing their current life stage and concerns

bilianadearly.name: Biliana Dearly
bilianadearly.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
bilianadearly.description: I'm a psychotherapist, supervisor, and senior lecturer in Melbourne. I currently lecture and supervise in the Master of Counselling and Psychotherapy Program at the Cairnmillar Institute, work part-time in private practice and deliver Foundation and Certification Programme workshops in Focusing-Oriented Therapy. My work is informed by in-depth and extensive training in humanistic, process-experiential and existential theory and practice and by my on-going commitment to expanding my awareness through the practice of Focusing.
bilianadearly.specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

kerrileewalsingham.name: Kerrilee Walsingham
kerrileewalsingham.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
kerrileewalsingham.description: I am a Registered Clinical Counsellor with 13 years experience. We all find life confusing and difficult to navigate at times and I love to support clients through whatever challenges they are facing.

janiceobryan.name: Janice (Jen) O'Bryan
janiceobryan.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
janiceobryan.description: I work primarily with body based therapy using Breathwork. I am passionate about working with the whole person, body, mind, emotions and soul. I believe we need to access more than our mind to work deeply with our feelings, memories and trauma.
janiceobryan.specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

adamszmerling.name: Adam Szmerling
adamszmerling.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
adamszmerling.description: I believe most of our adult struggles are covert (or not so secret) enactments from our early childhood experiences which were inadequately processed. Part of this problematic processing comes from our immaturity as children, especially in the face of trauma or even new, difficult encounters, all of which have effects that leave marks, traces and unconscious criteria through which we use to select partners in love and work. His main approach is Lacanian psychoanalytic psychotherapy, and he also draws on schema therapy and Buddhist psychotherapy.

paulcullen.name: Paul Cullen

paulcullen.description: Areas listed on PACFA profile: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery.

simonbrown.description: For over seventeen years, Simon has been counselling people experiencing a variety of life and mental health challenges in his clinical practice. Every client is regarded by him as unique and is listened to with the greatest care. Simon believes that people are the experts in their own lives but, when they find themselves battered and bruised by life, sometimes it can be hard to see the solutions.

tamarahow.description: At The Counselling Avenue, we focus on client wellness believing that this is not the absence of unhappiness or sadness but the presence of gratitude, happiness and hope. We work in a holistic and integrative manner to find the inner strengths that our clients bring to therapy. Tamara is guided by her client’s needs and uses a range of therapeutic interventions such as person-centred, narrative, gestalt, strength-based and trauma-informed therapies.

lisamenzel.name: Lisa Menzel

I work collaboratively with people to increase insight, make the unconscious conscious, and help them learn to be with their pain in a way that is present. tanyashort.name: Tanya Short

I am experienced in supporting people across Australia from diverse cultures, languages, ethnicity, religion, race, gender and socio-economic background, who are going through complex mental health and other challenges. Whether you are experiencing the impacts of trauma, grief, going through relationship challenges, experiencing low moods, lack of motivation, having work stress, feeling anxious, burnt-out or just stuck, we can work together collaboratively to find what works for you to live a fuller life, meeting your goals and needs. My approach is integrative, person centred, trauma-informed, and strength based.

She is passionate about creating a supportive space where practitioners can reflect on their work, build clinical confidence, navigate challenges and continue to grow both personally and professionally.

These can include issues with relationships, conflicts at work, parenting challenges, life choices, achieving goals, depression, anxiety, self esteem, negative feelings, destructive patterns of behaviour, stress, trauma, grief, anger, shame and despair. This therapeutic relationship offers the client new experiences that facilitate transformational change and personal growth.

hilinahagos.name: Hilina Hagos
hilinahagos.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
hilinahagos.description: Hi, I’m Hilina—a registered psychotherapist and counsellor committed to providing a safe, supportive, and non-judgmental space where you can explore your thoughts, emotions, and life experiences. Whether you're facing anxiety, depression, trauma, identity shifts, or relationship challenges, I offer a compassionate and culturally responsive approach tailored to your unique story. If you're dealing with unresolved trauma, grief, or identity shifts, I offer a calm, grounding presence and tools to move forward. As someone who values diversity, I honour the intersection of mental health with race, ethnicity, culture, gender, and faith.

tesstokatlidis.name: Tess Tokatlidis
tesstokatlidis.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
tesstokatlidis.description: I am a trauma informed counsellor and qualified Clinical Somatic Psychotherapist. I work within a client centred approach and am informed by attachment, self psychological, inter-subjective, somatic and trauma theories. PTSD and complex PTSD, depression, anxiety, confusion, self-image, relationship issues, life transitions, grief and loss, stress, relationship issues, phobias, communication challenges and anger are some areas of my expertise.
tesstokatlidis.specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

lukaswooller.description: Do you feel stuck, overwhelmed, or at the mercy of your emotions? I work with adults experiencing anxiety, depression, trauma, stress, anger, low self-esteem, relationship difficulties, life transitions, childhood trauma, addiction and existential concerns.

I believe that therapy is a natural collaborative process of co-regulation and inner enquiry that simply creates the ideal conditions for healing to occur.

Ritchie incorporates various evidence-based treatments including EMDR therapy, Cognitive Behavioural Therapy, Mindfulness, Relaxation, Hypnosis and Ego State Therapy to ensure that clients obtain a carefully-tailored experience with the best possible outcomes. He is experienced at dealing with a range of mental health issues but has a particular interest in the treatment of PTSD, childhood trauma, abuse and long-standing chronic depression and anxiety.

Trauma, Eating disorder, Sexual health, work with young people (ages 10+) and adults (18-65 years).
Utilise EMDR, DBT, ACT, CBT, Nature therapy, and yoga for trauma with clients, and encourage green and social prescribing whenever possible.

shelleyamity.name: Shelley Amity
shelleyamity.title: Psychologist
shelleyamity.description: Hello I'm a mindful registered psychologist with a wealth of clinical experience and has specialised in EMDR Therapy for Trauma, PTSD, Anxiety, Depression, Grief & Loss and more. Aiming to help adults from all walks of life to overcome psychological distress and trauma, develop essential coping skills and step-by-step strategies, to achieve a meaningful, happier, and healthier live.
shelleyamity.specialties:
“Be yourself, everything else is taken”, Oscar Wild.
I encourage each client to identify their uniqueness and being unafraid to express their individuality to create an independent and meaningful life.
Overall, I have extensive clinical experience working with a diverse client group with complex presentation, such as victims of trauma in the context of my previous role at the Trauma Centre of Aust

kavehkawabevrani.name: Kaveh Kawa Bevrani
kavehkawabevrani.title: Counsellor, Social Worker
kavehkawabevrani.description: Kawa / Kaveh is a compassionate mental health clinician with over seven years’ experience supporting individuals through anxiety, depression, trauma, and life challenges. Kawa works with people experiencing a wide range of difficulties, including emotional overwhelm, relationship struggles, low self-esteem, the effects of past trauma, and ongoing stress. He has particular expertise in working with complex and developmental trauma, including experiences of childhood abuse or neglect, as well as sexual assault, domestic violence, and alcohol and other drug (AOD) concerns. His work is grounded in attachment-informed, client-centred, and evidence-based approaches, drawing on therapies such as EMDR, Schema Therapy, ACT, DBT, MBT, Ego-State Therapy, and CBT.
kavehkawabevrani.specialties: Trauma-focused therapy, attachment-informed practice, personality disorders, parenting, and a diverse range of therapy modalities including psychodynamic, CBT, DBT, IFS, IPT, ACT, schema therapy, and polyvagal theory.

kay-shereespurling.specialties: Anxiety, ADHD, ASD, Addiction, Trauma, Depression, behavioural concerns, adjustment to parenthood, workplace issues, burnout, and managing life transitions. arnauddomange.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
arnauddomange.description: Bonjour, My therapeutic approach is Person-Centered, attachment-based, and psychodynamic, with a strong emotion-focused and body-aware orientation. I work in a direct yet respectful manner, helping individuals understand not only what they are struggling with but also why specific patterns, emotions, or difficulties recur. Rather than focusing solely on symptom management, I aim to work with the underlying emotional, relational, and attachment-based processes that shape distress.

noyonikabanik.name: Noyonika Banik
noyonikabanik.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
noyonikabanik.description: As a dedicated counsellor, I provide compassionate, evidence-based support to children, adults, and families navigating life’s challenges. With extensive experience in areas such as trauma, mental health, and family dynamics, I create a warm, non-judgmental space where clients feel understood and empowered. My approach focuses on fostering resilience and emotional well-being, helping clients not just cope but thrive.

My approach is compassionate, collaborative, and grounded in the belief that healing happens within a trusting therapeutic relationship.

I work with children, teenagers, and adults using narrative therapy, expressive arts, IFS-informed approaches, somatic work, and ACT, adapting my style to suit each person. I have conducted group therapy and also worked one-on-one with individual clients from varying backgrounds including family violence, complex needs, bereavement, grief & profound loss, anxiety issues and complex mental health issues. My empathetic and non-judgemental approach caters to clients from varying multi-cultural background, age, gender and race.

My approach integrates a rich tapestry of therapeutic modalities through a strength-based approach weaving in symbolic work, Eastern practices, nature-based therapy, and psychodynamic therapy tailored to empower you on your journey toward healing. Taking the first step to seeking a more fulfilling and happier life takes courage.
kamilaschneltser.specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy

Our service is offered face to face or telehealth, whatever works for you. There are many programs available for those in addiction but few for those who support or live closely with them, and it is stressful and wearing.

I provide counselling to adults impacted by complex trauma, as well as parent/caregiver victim-survivors of FV (especially where consent cannot be obtained for a child victim-survivor to access therapy). I have extensive experience in the Family Violence sector & am thrilled to have added EMDR with adults & children to my list of therapeutic services.

chrissyclarke.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
chrissyclarke.description: Areas listed on PACFA profile: Trauma recovery.

annahenry.name: Anna Henry
annahenry.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)

rachaelmillsom.name: Rachael Millsom
rachaelmillsom.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
rachaelmillsom.description: Rachael works collaboratively with her clients, often using nature, mindfulness, somatic resources and creative therapies. Rachael is trained as a level 1 sensorimotor psychotherapist, exploring ways patterns from our past, including trauma, show up in the body. Rachael is also informed in her work by ideas from narrative therapy, strength based approaches, attachment theory, and systems theory.
rachaelmillsom.specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

dalitbar.name: Dalit Bar
dalitbar.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
dalitbar.description: At Mindsight Counselling, I offer a calm and supportive space for adults, children, and families seeking counselling and art therapy in Bayside Melbourne. With over 20 years’ experience in counselling and art therapy across Melbourne, I work with warmth, curiosity, and respect to help clients make sense of what’s feeling difficult and move towards greater clarity, balance, and emotional wellbeing. I support clients through anxiety, grief and loss, life transitions, relationship challenges, and feeling emotional overwhelmed.

annamariesteyn.name: Anna Marie Steyn
annamariesteyn.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
annamariesteyn.description: "Where connection meets healing through creative expression". My approach is person-centred and integrative, drawing from evidence-based modalities including Internal Family Systems (IFS), trauma-informed practices and CBT. Whether you're navigating loss, processing trauma, or seeking support through life's transitions, I'm here to walk alongside you.

haraldriedel.name: Harald Riedel
haraldriedel.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
haraldriedel.address: Beach Street Allied Health     103 Beach Street
haraldriedel.description: As well as working in private practice, Harald assumes another role, which encompasses mental health program worker at an Adult Prevention and Recovery Centre (APARC) for a mental health and disability organisation. In addition, Harald facilitates mindfulness, meditation, and therapeutic groups both within the community and organisational context. Harald has an extensive history of practical experience and knowledge, including over six years working in mental health and several years in hospital and rehabilitation settings.
haraldriedel.specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

liatkremer.name: Liat Kremer

traceyyeoman.name: Tracey Yeoman
traceyyeoman.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
traceyyeoman.description: Tracey is the founder of Kitsune Coaching Solutions; her vision is to help all people find their balance for a better quality of life. Her ideal client may be struggling with authenticity, confidence, and life challenges: They may be exploring their Identity, learning to set boundaries, wanting to learn techniques to manage stress, building self-esteem and learning communication techniques. Coming from a fitness background and having a significant amount of neurodiversity and gender diversity in my world which also informs my perspective that we are all unique and can thrive.

tracitucker.name: Traci Tucker
tracitucker.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
tracitucker.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: LGBTIQA+, Sex Therapy, Transgender affirming care, Trauma.

umasymons.name: Uma Symons
umasymons.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
umasymons.description: Therapy is a highly individual experience that should centre your needs and your level of comfort. Uma provides a warm and empathetic approach to therapy, with an appreciation for what your unique strengths and insights can bring to therapy. Uma has lived experience as a person with ADHD, as well as experience building community within environmental and youth advocacy spaces.

vanessaorsborn.name: Vanessa Orsborn
vanessaorsborn.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 3)
vanessaorsborn.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: LGBTIQA+, Sex Therapy, Transgender affirming care, Trauma.
