yihuazhang.name: Yihua Zhang
yihuazhang.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
yihuazhang.description: Child and Adolescent Counselling. School Counsellor. Master of Counselling.

zixianzhang.name: Zixian Zhang
zixianzhang.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 3)
zixianzhang.description: I'm a registered Level 3 Mental Health Counsellor with the Australian Counselling Association and a Clinical Registrant with the Psychotherapy and Counselling Federation of Australia (PACFA). I work with adults and adolescents aged 15 and over, and have extensive experience supporting individuals with ADHD and Autism. I strive to create a neurodiversity-affirming, trauma-informed, inclusive, and culturally-sensitive space where you can feel safe, seen, and supported.

alexandracrouch.name: Alex Crouch
alexandracrouch.title: Counsellor (ACA Provisional)
alexandracrouch.description: As a passionate registered counsellor and psychotherapist in Melbourne, I offer in person and online sessions to help my clients navigate life's challenges, and make the transition towards happier, healthier, and more fulfilling futures.

alisonlovett.name: Alison Lovett
alisonlovett.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
alisonlovett.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: Sex Therapy, Trauma.

rickyelkins.name: Ricky Elkins
rickyelkins.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
rickyelkins.address: 1 St Heliers Street, The Wellbeing Wing
rickyelkins.description: I aim to offer a space where people can slow down and begin to make sense of experiences that feel stuck, challenging, or difficult to hold alone. You may find yourself here in the midst of transition, loss, relational difficulty, or uncertainty - or simply when familiar ways of living or coping no longer feel sustainable, and life begins to feel less steady than before. In this work, we turn toward what is present with care and curiosity - the patterns, the parts, the places in you that formed long ago in response to life, relationships, and the broader environments you have moved through.

sophielord.name: Sophie Lord
sophielord.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
sophielord.description: I’m a person centred, compassionate and empathic psychotherapist who works primarily with adults with Complex Trauma. I specialise in working with survivors of Domestic and Family Violence. I also work with people experiencing depression, anxiety and can hold space for you in your grief.

mosesadepoju.name: Moses Adepoju
mosesadepoju.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
mosesadepoju.description: Dr Moses G Adepoju is a clinical social worker and a clinical counsellor, behaviovior support practitioner, a personal and executive coach, psychotherapist, and a professional supervisor. Dr Adepoju has a Bachelor of Social Work, Master of Counselling and PhD in Social Work, Graduate Diploma in Training and Development and Advanced Certified Personal and Executive Coach (ACPEC). Dr Adepoju is an accredited Social Worker (MAASW), ACSW, accredited AMHSW, registered clinical counsellor PACFA, ACA clinical counsellor, PACFA accredited supervisor, AASW accredited clinical supervisor, ACA clinical supervisor, FDR Practitioner.

lindahartley.name: Linda Hartley
lindahartley.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
lindahartley.description: I am a Melbourne-based Counsellor and Psychotherapist specialising in Relationship Satisfaction for Individuals and Couples. My treatment approach is predominantly person-centred, attachment trauma informed, and emotion focused; allowing me to help clients get in touch with their feelings, manage their emotional experiences, seek emotional connections with meaningful others, and express what they need in intimate relationships to feel safe, secure, and uniquely valued as they navigate processes of Finding Love, Keeping Love, and Losing Love. I am currently engaged in internationally accredited training in trauma informed emotion-focused therapy for individuals with the Australian Institute for Emotion-Focused Therapy (AIEFT).

rainali.name: Rain Ali
rainali.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
rainali.description: Areas listed on PACFA profile: Trauma recovery.

sallynicholls.name: Sally Nicholls
sallynicholls.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
sallynicholls.description: Offering behaviour Change therapeutic programs; individual counselling; relationship counselling; existential psychotherapy

juliaholda.name: Julia Holda
juliaholda.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
juliaholda.description: Integrative practitioner, drawing on knowledge from evidence-based modalities such as Positive Psychology and Solution-Focused approaches to help enhance well-being and influence individuals make positive changes in their lives. I integrate person-centred, existential, psychodynamic, solution-focused, gestalt and narrative modalities to work collaboratively with clients to determine the approach that best suits their needs. I offer professional and confidential counselling for individuals, families and couples experiencing low self-esteem, social and emotional issues, anxiety, depression, grief & loss, difficult life-transitions, relationship concerns, trauma, parenting issues, workplace stress, interpersonal communication and assertiveness.

heidirickard.name: Heidi Rickard
heidirickard.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
heidirickard.description: I offer a compassionate, holistic, and person-centred approach. I believe every person has inherent value and a meaningful story. I aim to create a safe, respectful, and supportive space where clients feel truly heard and understood.

allisonross.name: Allison Ross
allisonross.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
allisonross.description: Allison Ross — Specialist Couples Therapist & Registered Counsellor About My Practice Allison Ross is a highly qualified Counsellor and Specialist Couples Therapist with over 12 years of experience supporting clients through the intricate dynamics of love, connection, and personal growth. Her practice is built entirely on the principles of inclusivity, safety, and respect, welcoming individuals and couples across all sexualities, genders, neurotypes, cultures, and lived experiences. Her individual practice focuses on helping clients build self-esteem, master assertiveness, and process the long-term impacts of childhood trauma or family estrangement.

amymulcahy.name: Amy Mulcahy
amymulcahy.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
amymulcahy.description: You might be feeling overwhelmed, disconnected, or unsure where to start — and that’s okay. You don’t have to have the right words or a clear plan. If you’re looking for a supportive, non-judgmental space to explore what’s going on and move forward at your own pace, I’m here to help.

andreamurray.name: Andrea Murray
andreamurray.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
andreamurray.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: Sex Therapy, Trauma.

andrewtravis.name: Andrew Travis
andrewtravis.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
andrewtravis.description: Are you looking for a counsellor who can really hear you well and support you to find your own solutions? Whether you're going through some personal challenges, or just want help to clarify your next move. Get insight and help around various issues, including: Addiction; depression; anxiety & stress; grief; mood disorder; mental & emotional well-being; sex, love & relationships, men's issues.

anncox.name: Ann Cox
anncox.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 3)
anncox.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: Sex Therapy.

ashleymacklin.name: Ashley Macklin
ashleymacklin.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 3)
ashleymacklin.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: LGBTIQA+, Sex Therapy, Trauma.

rebeccawanyoike.name: Becky Wanyoike
rebeccawanyoike.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 3)
rebeccawanyoike.description: I am Becky Wanyoike with over 12 years experience, passionate about helping individuals navigate life's challenges and achieve greater wellbeing. my areas of expertise include trauma, relationships issues, grief and general life stressors. I utilize a person-centre approach, which means I believe you have the capacity for growth and self-healing. our sessions focus on creating a safe and supportive space for to explore your thoughts, feelings, and experiences. Together, will work collaboratively to develop strategies and tools to empower you on your journey towards a more fulfilling life.

amandathornbury.name: Amanda Thornbury
amandathornbury.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
amandathornbury.description: Amanda is the founder of Intrinsic Healing Space, a private counselling practice built on the belief that people hold an intrinsic capacity for growth, healing and change. Amanda supports people experiencing workplace stress, burnout, anxiety, trauma recovery, overwhelm, loss of confidence and life transitions, as well as those times when life simply feels harder than it used to. Alongside counselling, Amanda is a We Al-li facilitator in Dadirri (deep listening) and culturally informed, trauma-integrated programs.

elenasansoni.name: Elena Sansoni
elenasansoni.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
elenasansoni.description: I am a PACFA Certified Practising Counsellor and child and family therapist, and the founder of North Star Child Therapy in Bayside Melbourne. I work with children, pre-teens, teenagers and parents, with a particular interest in anxiety, trauma, emotional regulation and behaviour. My approach is child-centred, trauma-informed and attachment-focused, drawing on evidence-based therapies including Child-Centred Play Therapy, CBT, ACT and Trauma-Focused CBT.

cindymelksham.name: Cindy Melksham
cindymelksham.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
cindymelksham.description: Cindy Melksham is a PACFA registered counsellor offering counselling for adolescents and adults both in-person in Footscray, Melbourne, and online across Australia. Cindy supports clients experiencing performance anxiety, social anxiety, trauma, stress and confidence challenges. Her approach is warm, collaborative and trauma-informed, with a focus on creating a safe space where clients feel understood and supported. These modalities can support deeper emotional regulation, trauma integration and lasting change.

aimeerobinson.name: Aimee Robinson
aimeerobinson.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
aimeerobinson.description: Specialists in the treatment of depression and premenstrual disorders such PMDD (Premenstrual Dysphoric Disorder) and PME (Premenstrual Exacerbation). Aimee has assisted many clients to uncover a meaningful life worth celebrating and sustained change. Aimee works with adults diagnosed with depression, adjustment disorder or experiencing symptoms of anxiety and depression and mood disorders such as: • Major Depressive Disorder • Acute Depression (mild, moderate, severe and extremely severe) • Pre-Menstrual Dysphoric Disorder • Adjustment Disorder (Life Transitions) • Grief and Loss Professional services offered: • Counselling and Psychotherapy Private Health Insurance rebates for eligible clients. • Medibank Private • AHM • HCF • Bupa • Police Health (ARHG) • Emergency Services Health (ARHG) To book an appointment click on the link: https://www.yourlifeincolour.com.au/book-online

reneespencer.name: Renee Spencer
reneespencer.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
reneespencer.description: Renee is a trauma-informed mental health practitioner with lived experience of high-control groups, both religious and non-religious. Her work is client-centred and grounded in evidence-based frameworks. She cares deeply about helping people reclaim self-determination and build lives that feel authentic and truly their own.

annabadcock.name: Anna Badcock
annabadcock.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
annabadcock.address: Camberwell Therapy Hub, Suite 7 & 11, 493 Riversdale Rd
annabadcock.description: I am a trauma-informed, person-centred therapist with a Master of Counselling and Psychotherapy. As a PACFA accredited practitioner, I am committed to ethical practice, providing a supportive environment where you will feel heard and understood. I work collaboratively with each individual to provide therapy that is tailored to your needs and circumstances.

jodykingston.description: Areas listed on PACFA profile: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery.

andrewcampbell-fraser.name: Andrew Campbell-Fraser
andrewcampbell-fraser.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
andrewcampbell-fraser.description: Hi, I’m Andrew — Welcome to All the difference, based in Eltham VIC, serving people throughout Nillumbik and beyond. I offer: - Counselling — for adults, one-on-one - Psychotherapy — for adults, one-on-one - Skills development — including the DBT-informed Skills for life program - Group facilitation — including a Men’s circle and facilitation for organisations I hold a PACFA-accredited Master of Counselling and Psychotherapy (Holistic Practice), Metavision Institute and specialist training through the Association of Psychological Therapies UK/Australia My registration is PACFA Reg. This includes complex trauma (cPTSD).

sarahsacks.name: Sarah Sacks
sarahsacks.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
sarahsacks.description: I offer grounded, thoughtful therapy for people navigating the ups and downs of life. Relationships, anxiety, depression, grief, loss, parenting, trauma, and neurodivergence are all areas that I support my clients to grow within everyday. As an experienced therapist, I tailor the the experience to meet where you are at.
sarahsacks.specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

bodhipriti.name: Bodhi Priti
bodhipriti.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
bodhipriti.description: My way of working is within a client-centred approach, to help deepen understandings of the challenges that bring you to therapy along with your hopes and goals. My work draws upon many frameworks, that include a developmental and trauma-informed lens, attachment theory, feminism, emotion focused approaches and family therapy. I bring an understanding of ourselves as multi-faceted humans that informs a soul centred approach.
bodhipriti.specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

katherinemcmahon.name: Kate McMahon
katherinemcmahon.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
katherinemcmahon.description: I’m a warm, gentle and creative therapist in Melbourne, dedicated to helping you find joy, ease and strength during difficult times, and supporting you to find new ways of understanding through creative approaches. I draw on gestalt, somatic and creative arts therapies to support you in this journey. I am a Registered Music Therapist, and a Registered Clinical Counsellor, offering a supportive space for making sense of your experiences in more ways than words.

davidcronin.name: David Cronin
davidcronin.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
davidcronin.description: David has been providing counselling, therapeutic group work, and mental health and wellbeing education to individuals, couples, and organisations for over twenty years. David has over 5000 hours of counselling experience, helping people with a wide range of presenting issues such as anxiety, depression, grief and loss, trauma, and complex relational, developmental and behavioural challenges. Working in the humanistic tradition David strives to help people find or regain their personal agency and self-compassion with a view to them living their best life.
davidcronin.specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing

kimstorey.name: Kim Storey
kimstorey.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
kimstorey.description: Areas listed on PACFA profile: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery.

bilijanapopovska.name: Bilijana Popovska
bilijanapopovska.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
bilijanapopovska.description: ﻿ Naum Centre is a compassionate and professional counselling service dedicated to supporting individuals through life’s challenges. With a background in social work and extensive experience in mental health, trauma, attachment, anxiety, depression, and grief, I understand the complexities of the human experience. Whether you’re navigating loss, struggling with self-doubt, or working through past trauma, I offer a space where you can feel heard, understood, and empowered. I integrate evidence-based therapeutic approaches, including trauma-informed care, narrative therapy, solutions focussed, and cognitive-behavioral strategies, to tailor our sessions to your needs. My approach is client-centred and evidence-based, integrating trauma-informed care, mindfulness, and cognitive-behavioural strategies to help you develop insight, resilience, and self-compassion.

carmenyoong.name: Carmen Yoong
carmenyoong.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
carmenyoong.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: LGBTIQA+, Sex Therapy, Trauma.

chantalburchett.name: Chantal Burchett
chantalburchett.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
chantalburchett.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: LGBTIQA+, Sex Therapy.

cobyliew.name: Coby Liew
cobyliew.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
cobyliew.description: G’day, I’m Dr Coby. I’m a Psychotherapist, Counsellor, Accredited Mental Health Social Worker (AMHSW), and Specialist Family Violence Practitioner with more than 15 years of experience in psychotherapy, counselling, and forensic mental health social work practice. Originally from Borneo, I have lived and worked across several countries before making Australia my home.

edinatugui.name: Edina Tugui
edinatugui.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 3)
edinatugui.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: LGBTIQA+, Sex Therapy, Trauma.

elenalyubimova.name: Elena Lyubimova
elenalyubimova.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
elenalyubimova.description: Hi, I’m Ali (short for Elena). I’m a registered counsellor, and for the past four years I’ve been supporting people through emotional challenges, life changes, and periods of feeling stuck or overwhelmed . My work with people is deeply personal, shaped by lived experience and a genuine respect for the complexity of emotional and relational life.

emmawilliams.name: Emma Williams
emmawilliams.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
emmawilliams.description: Are you sad, stuck, distressed or worried? With a warm, compassionate approach, I work with individuals, couples, families, children & adolescents. I can help you with: - anxiety and depression - grief, loss and trauma - attachment (including ideal parent figure) - conflict that is ongoing and distressing - broken trust and betrayal - sex and intimacy issues - navigating big life decisions - parenting difficulties - navigating ADHD (VAST) and Autism With a Master of Counselling, I have the expertise to support you to find new ways to manage entrenched difficulties.

julessilva.name: Jules Silva
julessilva.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
julessilva.address: Offer both face-to-face and Online/Telehealth sessions
julessilva.description: Life can be so tough, at times: Perhaps you don’t feel good about 'you', you struggle with life feeling relentlessly stressful, expensive, and anxiety-provoking, your relationship is in trouble, work is overwhelming and unsatisfying, your friendships feel insecure, you grieve for the decline or death of a close other (or beloved pet), you are diagnosed with a fear-evoking illness, your mental health is out of kilter and you don't know how to get back on track, or you may be feeling a 'deep down' loss of meaning and purpose in an increasingly unstable and uncertain world. Or something else; we all have a story. Whilst I have particular interest in grief and loss, trauma, existential concerns (incl. climate change and related anxieties), and emotional self-regulation, I am deeply interested in all aspects of the experience and suffering that clients and couples bring 'to the room'.
julessilva.specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

moniqueaspiteri.name: Moniquea Spiteri
moniqueaspiteri.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
moniqueaspiteri.description: Areas listed on PACFA profile: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery.
moniqueaspiteri.specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy

karolinakrysinska.name: Karolina Krysinska
karolinakrysinska.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
karolinakrysinska.description: I am a Gestalt psychotherapist with a background in psychology and 25 years of experience in the field of mental health. My work is based on respectful exploration of client’s experience in the here and now, including our ongoing psychotherapy relationship. My interest in Gestalt psychotherapy reflects my passion for a deeper understanding of psychological and emotional well-being and satisfactory human relationships.

hannahbruce.name: Hannah Bruce
hannahbruce.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
hannahbruce.description: Hannah is a specialist trauma counsellor with deep experience supporting adult survivors of childhood trauma, complex PTSD, addiction, and victims of crime including those engaging with the National Redress Scheme. Hannah has worked across community mental health, addiction recovery, and trauma support services. Her practice is informed by EFT, somatic counselling, motivational interviewing, and the Blue Knot Foundation’s Clinical Practice Guidelines for Complex Trauma. Her areas of speciality include: • Childhood trauma and abuse • Complex PTSD and dissociation • Attachment and relational trauma • Substance use and addiction • Victims of crime and institutional harm • Emotional regulation, grief, and identity Hannah offers a compassionate, steady presence and works at a pace that respects each client’s safety and readiness.
hannahbruce.specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy

danielperkins.name: Daniel Perkins
danielperkins.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
danielperkins.description: Specialising in the use of neurofeedback for the treatment of anxiety, depression, PTSD, complex/childhood trauma, ADHD.

juliagorda.name: Julia Gorda
juliagorda.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
juliagorda.practice: The Path to Balance Yoga and Counselling
juliagorda.description: My approach is trauma-informed, relational, and body-based, integrating traditional counselling with yoga-informed therapeutic practices to support nervous system regulation, recovery, and emotional balance. I work in a collaborative and non-judgemental way, supporting clients to build awareness of patterns, reconnect with their bodies, and develop greater choice and self-support in the present moment. My work is informed by Gestalt therapy principles, particularly in the context of addiction and recovery, helping clients explore how stress, trauma, and substance use impact both inner experience and relationships.

waltraudreiner.name: Waltraud Reiner
waltraudreiner.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
waltraudreiner.description: Growing up in a rural country in Austria has given me a strong sense for improvising and seeing materials out of context. To address her own experience of trauma and adversity, Waltraud has learnt the value of analytic therapy. Just as a painter needs to discover the skills to select brushes and paints, so do our psyches need to discover which parts of themselves to shine and polish.
waltraudreiner.specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

bharatisusarla.name: Bharati Susarla
bharatisusarla.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
bharatisusarla.description: I offer a compassionate counselling service that is both sensitive and understanding of cultural context. In the therapeutic space that I will create for you, you will be at all times treated with respect and genuinity of care and understanding. I am very particular about listening to what you have to say and in doing so, will be able to sensitively help you explore those aspects of your life, emotions, thoughts and feelings that may be causing you pain.

erinprater.name: Erin Prater
erinprater.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
erinprater.description: As a Certified Clinical Complex Trauma Professional, Certified Narcissistic Abuse Treatment Clinician, Sex Therapy Informed Practitioner and Level 2 Registered Counsellor and I acce pt clients with moderate support needs. Together we can explore, relationship stress, decision making challenges, or impacts to daily living, whilst developing skills that can help to regulated symptoms activated by anxiety and panic, depression, C/PTSD and PTSD. I aim to provide care tailored to meet your need.

georgenelson.name: George Nelson
georgenelson.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
georgenelson.description: George is a qualified psychotherapist, coach, clinical counsellor, relationship therapist, educator, speech therapist, voice production and training consultant. George has worked in a range of public sector roles in addition to an independent practice as a clinician, senior executive, manager, supervisor and training consultant. As a therapist and educator George has worked with children, teenagers and adults to help them with cognition, behaviour, decision making, social and emotional intelligence, communication, speech, voice production - (certain clients include news-presenters, actors, reporters and radio announcers).

gustavogibelli.name: Gustavo Gibelli
gustavogibelli.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
gustavogibelli.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: Sex Therapy, Trauma.

hollyblock.name: Holly Block
hollyblock.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
hollyblock.description: Our relationships can heal us, but not in the ways we commonly think – not by controlling our partners or getting from them what we lacked as children. Rather, we heal by coming to terms with the ignored parts of ourselves. We acknowledge our wounded, triggered responses and shift into something wiser, more mature.

irenabegelfor.name: Irena Begelfor
irenabegelfor.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
irenabegelfor.description: THE JOURNEY THAT LED ME HERE … As a way of getting to know each other, I want to share where I have come from and why I chose to be a life coach/hypnotherapist. For much of my adult life I worked in the area of Information Technology (IT) for large corporations within Australia and frequently travelled internationally to impart business and technical knowledge. I changed many hats throughout my professional career where I always developed both my creative as well as logical skills.

jacquelinetarabay.name: Jacqueline Tarabay
jacquelinetarabay.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
jacquelinetarabay.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: Sex Therapy, Trauma.

Specialising in addiction, trauma, grief and loss, her decades of experience provides her with exceptional skills to create safe spaces to work with co-occurring disorders through both a interpersonal clinical approach and somatic breathwork. Specialising in addiction, trauma, grief and loss. Psychology/ Counselling BA ACA member, Clinical Supervisor CSAT candidate( Certified Sex Addiction Therapist) Breathwork facilitator, Somatic Therapist Meditation teacher

Together we work to find compassion for self and a greater ease through a range of therapeutic modalities including Internal Family System (IFS), Schema, Acceptance and Commitment (ACT), Interpersonal and Mindfulness therapies, amongst others.

lukepepperell.description: I bring a grounded, practical and non judgemental approach to counselling, shaped by both professional experience and a real world understanding of the challenges people face throughout life. Over the past five years, I have worked closely with individuals and families connected to the prison system, supporting people navigating addiction, relationship difficulties, emotional distress, identity challenges and family disconnection. This experience has strengthened my ability to build genuine rapport with people from all walks of life and create a space where clients feel heard, respected and understood.

lyndacarlyle.name: Lynda Carlyle
lyndacarlyle.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
lyndacarlyle.description: Lynda Carlyle’s qualifications in the complementary areas of nursing, sexology, counselling, and couple’s therapy provide her with a breadth of knowledge to draw from. In a warm and encouraging space, Lynda offers a platform to share hopes and disappointments about sex, relationships, and life. For more than a decade, Lynda Carlyle has been working with people seeking understanding and help for problems with sex and intimacy , sexual problems / dysfunctions , and relationship issues . Her innovative and practical ideas can reduce anxiety, improve confidence with sex, help with sexual functioning, and increase sexual pleasure.

Knox Mindfulness is passionate about supporting individuals through challenging moments in life.

katherinereimer.name: Kate Reimer

katherinereimer.description: Kate is a registered counsellor working with adults, youth and children. Working from a trauma-informed approach, she prioritises establishing a safe and non-judgemental therapeutic relationship in which clients can begin to explore the issues important to them. Whether you are facing issues of grief and loss, depression or anxiety, childhood trauma, or you are wanting to live a more meaningful and fulfilling life, counselling can provide additional resources for healing, growing and living more authentically.
katherinereimer.specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

All practise carries Trauma Informed and Trauma Informed background and research based therapeutic approaches. ​ With a background in applied Linguistics and as a second language speaker, social, cross-cultural, religious and economic factors are always respected. These inform world-views that need to be appreciated and where appropriate integrated into the therapeutic process.

priscillalund.name: Priscilla Lund
priscillalund.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
priscillalund.description: Priscilla is the lead Clinical Counsellor Island Counselling and lead Well-being coach at Mindflex. ​At Island Counselling ( https://www.islandcounselling.com.au/ ), Priscilla offers professional, confidential counselling in Cowes, Phillip Island, for young adults, adults, older adults, and couples. Specialising in life transitions, Gottman Method couples therapy, relationships, mental health and well-being​ (stress, anxiety and depression), grief, career development, WorkSafe and NDIS support. Providing telehealth and in-person therapy to help you navigate challenges with resilience and confidence.

lindagraham.description: Linda is a warm, compassionate, and client-centred counselling practitioner who supports adults, youths and families experiencing anxiety, stress, relationship difficulties, life transitions, grief, low self-esteem, and emotional challenges. Linda's approach is grounded in creating a safe, confidential, and non-judgemental space where clients can feel heard, respected, understood, and supported. Linda works collaboratively with each client, recognising that everyone’s experiences and goals are unique.

I specialise in providing intensive somatic trauma, grief and loss therapy and provide individual and group clinical supervision. Clients I work within trauma and trauma related issues (including addictions, attachment disorders, eating disorders, anxiety, and depression), death, dying, grief, loss, and crisis. I am also trained in: * EMDR I, II, Masterclass, Accredited EMDR Practitioner * Somatic Trauma Therapist – 100 hour training with Babette Rothschild * Animal Assisted Psychotherapist, Foundation, Advanced, Masterclass, Accredited AAP Supervisor * Brainspotting Consultant and Supervisor, Phase I, II, III, IV, Intensive, Masterclass I am a past Victorian Board Member for The Australian Association of Supervisors.

bernadettemilsted.description: I have been a professional counsellor and psychotherapist for over 25 years. I have lectured in tertiary counselling and welfare courses, developed and facilitated group therapy programs, managed a Christian counselling organisation, worked in counselling teams in general practice, in Palliative care, Dementia Care and private practice. My experience includes grief and loss, family, carer stress, couples and individual psychotherapy, PTSD, anxiety and trauma, life transitions and abuse.

matthewraker.name: Matthew Raker
matthewraker.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
matthewraker.description: As an accomplished Counsellor (PACFA) and Social Worker (AASW), I am passionate about creating authentic therapeutic relationships that empower individuals to overcome challenges and realise their full potential. With a rich academic background, including a Bachelor of Social Science (Criminal Justice), Graduate Diploma of Counselling, Master of Counselling & Psychotherapy, and a Master of Social Work (Qualifying) with merit, I bring a diverse skill set to my practice. I specialise in trauma-informed care, addressing issues such as PTSD, single incident/complex trauma, general and social anxiety, depression, grief and loss, phobias, personal and career development, assertiveness training, life direction/transition, confidence building, motivation, self-esteem, stress reduction, anger management, pain management, addiction, and relationship challenges.

barrylaing.description: I live in Preston, Melbourne, VIC with my partner and daughter. I completed a Masters degree in Gestalt therapy in 2018. As a counsellor and psychotherapist, I am passionate about developing dialogue with and support for people that affirms them in their experience, grows awareness, and fosters agency and change.

Our focus is to help clients tune into their own authentic self-expression & personal power, through creative and collaborative therapeutic techniques.

alfonsopavon.name: Alfonso Pavon
alfonsopavon.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
alfonsopavon.description: Integrative Counselling supports overthinkers, high achievers, and LGBTQIA+ people navigating anxiety, burnout, and recurring relationship patterns. Sessions combine talk therapy with nervous system regulation, using evidence-based somatic, attachment-focused, and trauma-informed approaches to help you feel calmer, more grounded, and more connected in your life and relationships. I offer individual counselling in English and Spanish, online and in person in Melbourne, with flexible appointments and a collaborative, culturally affirming approach tailored to your needs.

amandaegan.name: Amanda Egan

amandaegan.description: I’m Amanda Egan, and I am excited to be a dedicated counsellor at Karinya Farm. My role here is to support individuals on their journey toward personal growth and well-being by providing a warm, professional and empathetic environment where clients can explore their challenges and achieve their goals. If you are navigating life transitions, seeking emotional support, or striving for personal development, I am here to help.

Sarah works from a trauma-informed and neurodiversity-affirming approach. In addition to her formal training, Sarah also values her lived experience of the personal and family impacts of mental ill-health, late diagnosed neurodiversity, trauma and addiction.

meghantozer.description: I am a qualified counsellor, working in both the in-room counselling space and with equine assisted therapy. Helping people express themselves through connection with horses, I use animal assisted therapy to help adolescents, children and adults navigate anxiety, social anxiety, self-esteem and confidence issues, life transitioning, parenting stresses, grief and loss and trauma.

rachelkleinman.name: Rachel Kleinman
rachelkleinman.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
rachelkleinman.description: I believe that creating a safe, supportive space for therapy can allow for the exploration of life struggles, painful events and relationship issues, eventually creating the powerful potential for healing and change in people’s lives. I have specialist experience and interest in working with grief and loss. I have worked extensively with families grieving the death of a baby or child.

karenthomas.name: Karen Thomas
karenthomas.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
karenthomas.practice: Karen Sri Thomas Counselling & Psychotherapy, (Hummingbird Therapy)
karenthomas.description: Your concerns might relate to anxiety, depression, relationship difficulties, grief at the loss of a loved one or a job, or low self-esteem. Alternatively, you're a survivor of family domestic abuse wanting to move through your trauma and heal. Together, we'll identify your best ways of releasing the burdens of stress, tension, and past trauma in your healing journey in ways that are unique to you. Within the counselling process and in conjunction with my diverse cultural background and my trauma-informed, integrative approaches, I have witnessed many clients over many sessions experience shifts and ultimately relief as they release these burdens experientially.
karenthomas.specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing

racheldurrant.description: CuriousNeuro Counselling was born from both professional expertise and lived experience. Founded by Rachel, who was diagnosed with ADHD at 39 years young, we specialise in empowering adults who have received a later-in-life neurodevelopmental diagnosis. We provide 100% online telehealth counselling aimed at helping individuals embrace their neurodiversity and navigate the life changes and challenges that come with it.

shuwanashiraze.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
shuwanashiraze.description: Welcome to a space where you are invited to explore the deeper currents of your life and relationships. My approach is client-centered and trauma-informed, rooted in Relational Gestalt psychotherapy. I apply an integrative method informed by Emotionally-Focused Therapy, somatic practices, Depth Inquiry-EMDR, psychodynamic exploration, and non-dual wisdom. I also incorporate parts work and Relational Life Therapy to help you understand and harmonize the different aspects of yourself and your relationships. In our work, we honor the wisdom of the body and the intelligence of emotions, exploring how different parts of you interact and impact your relationships.

michellevankampen.name: Michelle van Kampen
michellevankampen.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
michellevankampen.description: Grounded in Gestalt psychotherapy and Polyvagal theory, Michelle offers holistic, trauma-informed therapy in Melbourne, and online for interstate clients. With over eight years’ experience in both community and private practice, she specialises in working with trauma and victim survivors, including those affected by family violence, sexual assault, and crime. Her background includes roles as a trauma counsellor, crisis clinician for at-risk youth, NDIS, and provider for the Victims of Crime Financial Assistance Scheme (FAS), formerly VOCAT. She consults regularly with international trauma specialists to maintain a reflective, embodied, and best-practice approach. She also provides supervision for professionals seeking to deepen their trauma-informed practice.

alexandracloumassis.description: I work in different ways with different people. I believe that distressed humans are not disordered or diseased, but are usually responding normally to abnormal or harmful environments or events. I believe in compassion and understanding over diagnosis.

She assists clients with challenging experiences, as well as their relationships with themselves, others and the world around them integrating PCT, CBT, DBT, ACT, SFBT and other modalities, adapting her approach to support each person's unique needs. Carolynne enjoys working with clients of all ages in a safe and non-judgemental way to support whatever difficulties they wish to explore including: anxiety, depression, traumatic experiences, grief and loss, suicidality and self-harm, as well as relationships and workplace concerns.

cenafarahmand.name: Cena Farahmand
cenafarahmand.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
cenafarahmand.description: Registered Counsellor (M.A.C.A) Cena Farahmand is a dedicated, culturally responsive registered counsellor committed to providing a safe, confidential, and non-judgmental space for individuals navigating life transitions, emotional stress, anxiety, and settlement challenges . With a deep commitment to mental health advocacy, particularly within Culturally and Linguistically Diverse (CALD) communities, Cena bridges critical support gaps by offering counselling in English, Dari, Hazaragi and Persian (Farsi) . His approach is grounded in empathy and person-centred care, empowering clients to untangle complex emotional patterns, regulate stress, and foster personal resilience at their own pace.

markwhalley.name: Mark Whalley
markwhalley.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
markwhalley.description: I work exclusively with adults, guided by three core principles: 1) “Meet the client where they are at.” 2) "The client needs an experience, rather than an explanation.” 3) “We are born in relationship, we are wounded in relationship, and we can be healed in relationship.” 1) Tailored, Collaborative Therapy Every client is unique, so I believe a ‘one-size-fits-all’ approach to therapy is inadequate. Instead, I practice Pluralistic Therapy, which allows us to co-create a therapeutic process that is tailored to the client’s individual needs. This integrative approach draws from a range of therapeutic modalities, including those listed below, and is informed by the latest research and theories in Intersubjectivity, Attachment, Trauma, Self-Compassion, and the Neuroscience of Psychotherapy. 2) The Power of Experience Over Explanation This principle builds on the first. However, when trauma, grief, or relationship challenges disrupt our inner narrative, that can create a sense of disconnection or overwhelm, often manifesting as anxiety, depression, or even somatic symptoms.

carmelnielsen.name: Carmel Nielsen
carmelnielsen.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
carmelnielsen.description: Carmel Nielsen is a Registered Clinical Counsellor with the Psychotherapy and Counselling Federation of Australia (PACFA). Her professional expertise spans therapeutic counselling, advocacy, crisis intervention, program development, and the coordination of multidisciplinary teams and external stakeholders. Carmel brings a deep commitment to inclusive, person-centred care and works with a broad scope of topics including emotion regulation, stress, motivation, trauma, self-concept, and workplace challenges.

fayewest.name: Faye West
fayewest.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
fayewest.description: I work with children and adults, drawing on modalities such as Narrative Therapy, Expressive Therapies including Sandplay Therapy and Symbol Work, and using a play therapy approach with children. My particular areas of interest are disenfranchised and complex grief, identity/self-esteem, life transitions and parenting. I also provide supervision.

vanessarohlf.name: Vanessa Rohlf
vanessarohlf.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
vanessarohlf.description: Dr Vanessa Rohlf is a counsellor, consultant and educator specialising in supporting people who care for animals. She is an associate member of the Australian Psychological Society and has further qualifications in mindfulness and animal bereavement as well as certification as a compassion fatigue therapist with the Green Cross Academy of Traumatology. She provides collaborative, evidence-based, and compassionate support in several areas including pet loss, depression, anxiety, grief, burnout, stress, compassion fatigue, and trauma.

coraclough.name: Cora Clough
coraclough.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
coraclough.description: Vedere Counselling, located in South Yarra, Melbourne, offers professional counselling services for individuals and couples facing challenges such as depression, anxiety, behavioural issues, relationship difficulties, substance abuse, stress, trauma, and grief. Led by registered clinical counsellor Cora Clough, the practice provides a safe, non-judgmental environment for clients to explore their thoughts and emotions. Cora's extensive background in social science and business enhances her therapeutic approach, fostering personal growth and resilience.

lisalovell.name: Lisa Lovell
lisalovell.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
lisalovell.description: Lisa is a Registered Clinical Counsellor and Yoga teacher. She works with children and adults who have experienced major life stressors (life transitions, anxiety and stress, depression, grief and loss) and trauma that may impact their quality of life and relationships. She works from a process-oriented perspective, and is client focused and dynamic with her therapeutic modalities which includes integrative mindful movements to help release stressors from the body.

niak.name: Nia K
niak.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
niak.description: Nia’s therapeutic practice is informed by her academic qualifications (Bachelor of Integrative Psychotherapy,Advanced Clinical Training in Relational Gestalt Psychotherapy,Graduate Certificate in Experiential & Creative Arts Practice,Advanced Diploma of Transpersonal Counselling) and life experience. She has a strong understanding of the connection between intergenerational trauma and the here and now experience of our lives. She explores what underlies many people’s experiences and the idea that trauma can be passed down from one generation to the next.
niak.specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

vanessablazey.name: Vanessa Blazey
vanessablazey.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
vanessablazey.description: Vanessa has lived experience of mental health challenges and as a client herself, she understands the profound value in having “the right fit” in a successful, professional client-counsellor relationship. When working with children, young people and adults who have experienced trauma this looks like working alongside the client’s health care professionals towards the same goal to avoid retraumatisation and ensure continuity and positive outcomes. Vanessa has worked as a counsellor in various services, including school settings, crisis support, drug and alcohol rehabilitation and across a broad range of issues including Anxiety, Depression, Trauma. Vanessa has a keen personal interest in maternal mental health, the mother-infant relationship, birth trauma and human rights.

sharonrowland.name: Sharon Rowland
sharonrowland.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
sharonrowland.description: Passionate about working alongside couples and individuals to realise their potential. I bring years of experience and training into a safe and welcoming space.

marcusmogford.name: Marcus Mogford
marcusmogford.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
marcusmogford.description: Marcus is a registered counsellor and Gestalt psychotherapist who has worked in a variety of mental health settings since 2016. His clinical practice has focused on areas such as anxiety, depression, trauma, self-esteem, grief, suicidal ideation, and challenges in relationships. Marcus primarily uses a Gestalt approach, but also draws on attachment theory, Internal Family Systems, relational neuroscience, trauma-informed treatment modalities, and psychospiritual approaches in accordance with the needs and interests of his clients.

kathytoomey.name: Kathy Toomey
kathytoomey.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
kathytoomey.practice: Kids and Teens Counselling and Psychotherapy
kathytoomey.description: I have over 20 years experience working with children and families in the education sector as teacher, leader and school counsellor/psychotherapist. In private practice I specialise in Counselling and Psychotherapy for Kids and Teens. (Ages 4-25).

karajohn.name: Kara John
karajohn.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
karajohn.description: Hi, my name is Kara. And as a therapist, I bring my whole self to you in an open, non-judgmental, and compassionate way. I became a counsellor later in life.
karajohn.specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

desankadesaogrizovic.name: Desanka Desa Ogrizovic
desankadesaogrizovic.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
desankadesaogrizovic.description: I am a Clinical Counsellor working within a multidisciplinary healthcare setting, providing psychological and emotional support to individuals undergoing bariatric and metabolic surgery. I support clients through evidence-informed counselling interventions that enhance insight, emotional regulation, coping skills, and sustainable habit change, recognising the complex interaction between mental health, stress, trauma, and physical wellbeing. I also practice through Desa Holistic Wellbeing ( www.desaholisticwellbeing.com.au ), where I provide counselling grounded in a holistic, client-centred, and trauma-informed framework.
desankadesaogrizovic.specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

dylanevans.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
dylanevans.description: I became a counsellor because I genuinely care about people's wellbeing. Creating a space where someone feels heard and supported, no matter what they're going through, is what this work is all about. I provide a welcoming and affirming space for LGBTQ+ clients.

ebrukavas.name: Ebru Kavas
ebrukavas.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
ebrukavas.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: LGBTIQA+, Trauma.

edwinabreitzke.name: Edwina Breitzke
edwinabreitzke.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
edwinabreitzke.description: Hello and welcome. I am an IFS specialist and Certified Level 3-trained Internal Family Systems (IFS) therapist , working online and based in Melbourne, Australia. I work with adults (18+) experiencing a wide range of concerns including anxiety, depression, trauma, attachment and relationship difficulties, shame, grief, life transitions, estrangement, and recovery from narcissistic abuse.

effiegray.name: Effie Gray
effiegray.title: Counsellor (ACA Proficient)
effiegray.description: At ME Animal Assisted Wellness we offer social and emotional learning and counselling in an alternative way. Inviting you to spend therapeutic time with our herd of horses and work through life challenges.

elliotcyngler.name: Elliot Cyngler

elliotcyngler.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: LGBTIQA+, Trauma.

sabrinamrozinski.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
sabrinamrozinski.description: Areas listed on PACFA profile: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery.

tammietran.name: Tammie Tran
tammietran.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
tammietran.description: Hello! I'm a certified practising counsellor with the Psychotherapy and Counselling Federation of Australia (PACFA), working with adult individuals and couples. Working from a non-pathologising perspective, I draw upon evidence-based models, such as a Strengths-Based Approach, Attachment Theory, Trauma-Informed Practice, Internal Family Systems (IFS), Solution-Focused Therapy, and Mindfulness.

katharineranken.name: Katharine Ranken
katharineranken.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
katharineranken.description: In my practice I hold the Mind-Body Connection as forefront to my therapeutic approach It's important to me that this therapeutic journey is useful and effective for you. With this in mind I will review with you on a regular basis whether the work is meeting your expectations. By invitation and your agreement I use many different body-mind integrated and experiential therapeutic interventions to assist you in working towards your desired outcomes Please see my website for more information

suzannehurley.name: Suzanne Hurley
suzannehurley.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
suzannehurley.description: Perinatal Mental Health & Fertility Counsellor Skype / Zoom / Phone Suzanne is a passionate, dedicated & clinically accredited counsellor (PACFA) who has specialised in the area of reproductive loss, including pregnancy options counselling, abortion counselling, infertility and IVF support and in perinatal mental health. She has provided her clients with counselling, group support and presented to health professionals in various perinatal settings. Her initial training at WIRE Womens's Information has provided her with understanding of the Feminist Framework and responding to family violence & sexual assault.

nerolieross.name: Nerolie Ross
nerolieross.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
nerolieross.description: Passion Counselling focuses on providing mental health support and therapy, predominantly for anxiety and depression as well as other related conditions.

ellendharmaraj.name: Ellen Dharmaraj
ellendharmaraj.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
ellendharmaraj.description: My aim is to create a safe road to recovery, toward the ultimate goal of not only feeling better, but also to go out in the world on your own with confidence. Whether it is major life challenges, unresolved feelings from the past or anxieties facing into your future, I'm your sounding board backed with accredited training and experience. Many clients say to me that I "just get it" and this is what I do best - helping you feel acknowledged, supported and understood.

sharonpeeters.name: Sharon Peeters
sharonpeeters.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
sharonpeeters.description: Sharon is committed to helping couples work through problems in a proactive and relational manner. Sharon has attained Level 3 Training in Gottman Method Couples Therapy and is undergoing certification to be a specialist. Sharon utilises evidenced based theories to work through issues such as: anxiety, depression, stress and burnout, addictions, boundary issues to addictions, trauma, loss and grief.

nidhikhanna.name: Nidhi Khanna
nidhikhanna.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
nidhikhanna.description: Hi! I am a certified practising Counsellor with experience in working with various presentations, including but not limited to stress, anxiety, depression, trauma and grief. I adopt a trauma-informed approach and draw upon various therapeutic modalities.

emmabaxter.name: Emma Baxter
emmabaxter.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
emmabaxter.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: LGBTIQA+, Trauma.

emmahiggins.name: Emma Higgins
emmahiggins.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
emmahiggins.description: I am a holistic counsellor who works from a spiritual framework, dedicated to helping individuals achieve well-being and personal growth. My specialization includes Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) and narrative therapy, both of which empower clients to embrace their experiences and reshape their personal stories. In addition, I incorporate Nature Therapy into my practice, leveraging the healing power of the natural world to foster deeper connections and promote mental and emotional health.

greciasanchez.name: Grecia Sanchez
greciasanchez.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
greciasanchez.description: I am committed to providing a safe, compassionate, and non-judgmental space where clients feel genuinely heard and supported. I understand that reaching out for support can feel vulnerable, particularly when living with anxiety, stress, or the impact of past experiences. I practise in a trauma-informed and client-centred way, recognising that many coping strategies developed as ways of surviving difficult experiences.

gwensolomou.name: Gwen Solomou
gwensolomou.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
gwensolomou.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: LGBTIQA+, Trauma.

harshanihewaalgiriyage.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
harshanihewaalgiriyage.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: LGBTIQA+, Trauma.

haydenmclachlan.name: Hayden McLachlan
haydenmclachlan.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
haydenmclachlan.description: therapy for the "i'm fine, thanks" crowd. ​i know it’s easy to keep up the mask—saying "i'm fine" or "yeah, not too bad" while carrying the heavy stuff alone. my goal is to create a space where you can move past that and talk about what's actually going on. ​as a younger practitioner, of the spiritual sort, i provide a calm and steady presence for men navigating the weight of modern life. i’m less interested in clinical jargon and more interested in the person sitting next to me. i specialize in helping men navigate the big questions of identity , how we relate to others , and career anxiety , as well as the unique challenges of addiction . ​we use evidence-based tools because they work, but the process is simple: just a proper conversation to propel you forward. not too much clinical talk—just a steady and listening hand to help you find your way through. when are you free? send me an email or text and let's chat. email: hayden@helpercounselling.au phone: 0405 687 918

heatherking.name: Heather King
heatherking.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
heatherking.description: I offer a compassionate, non-judgemental space for you to talk about what’s on your mind. As our body, mind and soul are all intertwined, I take a wholistic approach to give you the best chance of moving through your concerns and reaching your goals. Things I can help with: Anxiety and depression / low mood Work stress: work-life balance, bullying, finding meaning in your work life Loss and grief: impending or actual loss of a person, pet, job, or home, and less-visible losses, such as those that accompany a serious illness or injury Life transitions: new relationship, new baby, entering/leaving the workforce, children leaving home, parents (or yourself) going into care Exploring new directions you want to take or changes you want to make Visit my website to request a free, no-obligation 15-minute phone call to see if I might be the right counsellor for you: https://heatherkingcounselling.com.au/

helenwayland.name: Helen Wayland
helenwayland.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
helenwayland.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: LGBTIQA+, Trauma.

irenequintavalle.name: Irene Quintavalle
irenequintavalle.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 3)
irenequintavalle.description: Irene’s approach to therapy is deeply empathetic, relational, and attuned to each person’s unique experience. Drawing on her lived experience of trauma, attachment disturbances, and migration challenges, in her private practice, she supports people to heal deep wounds, cultivate meaningful relationships, and navigate life’s transitions within the safety of a therapeutic container. Grounded in Integrative Psychotherapy, Irene has enriched her practice through certifications in Integrative Attachment Therapy and further training in C-PTSD, Mentalisation-Based Techniques, Interpersonal therapies, Sensorimotor Psychotherapy, and EMDR.

jayanarayan.name: Jaya Narayan
jayanarayan.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
jayanarayan.description: I am a body-oriented and neurobiology-affirming based trauma therapist. I specialise in trauma-informed-bottom-up frameworks to support anyone experiencing the impact of complex trauma, chronic Stress/ pain, anxiety and burnout. I relationally attune to intersects the wisdom of expressive art(s), Psychodrama, somatics and group processes, allowing a whole body/ brain approach to therapeutic engagement.

jeanettedvorak.name: Jeanette Dvorak
jeanettedvorak.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
jeanettedvorak.description: I am a wellness coach & counsellor dedicated to guiding individuals and groups towards achieving optimal health and well-being. Utilizing an integrative approach, my mission is to empower others to be their best self. I help people make informed and sustainable lifestyle choices that nurture their physical, mental, and emotional wellness.

clairebaxter.name: Claire Baxter
clairebaxter.title: Psychologist, Psychoanalyst
clairebaxter.description: Claire Baxter works with patients who present with presentations ranging from stress and anxiety, depression, trauma, mood and personality disorders, neurodiversity and gender dysphoria. She offers talking therapy for these and many other conditions. Claire works with adolescents experiencing sadness, depression, anxiety, or gender dysphoria.
clairebaxter.specialties: Dissociative Disorders, Gender and Sexuality, PTSD, Sex Related Issues, Sexual Abuse, Trauma Recovery, Trauma-Informed

juliabediaga.name: Julia Bediaga
juliabediaga.title: Social Worker AMHSW
juliabediaga.description: Julia Bediaga is an accredited mental health social worker with extensive experience working in a variety of settings. She completed a Master of Social Work and a Bachelor of Arts majoring in Anthropology and Psychology. Julia uses a person-centered, trauma-informed and strengths-based approach to build a supportive space where individuals can feel free to safely explore their thoughts and feelings.
juliabediaga.specialties: Dissociative Disorders, Gender and Sexuality, PTSD, Sexual Abuse, Trauma Recovery, Trauma Sensitive Yoga, Trauma-Informed

johncameron.name: John Cameron
johncameron.title: Psychoanalyst, Counsellor
johncameron.description: Psychoanalysis creates a time and space where our most difficult thoughts and feelings can be voiced. By speaking without censorship in a safe and private environment, the unconscious causes of our deepest suffering can be acknowledged and ultimately their grip on our destiny loosened. People can bring a range of symptoms and diagnoses to the psychoanalytic clinic such as: • Depression and anxiety • Schizophrenia, bipolar, borderline or paranoid personality disorders • ADHD, ASD, PTSD and C-PTSD • Phobias, nightmares, insomnia • Addictions and eating problems Or distressing feelings and behaviours related to: • Sexuality or relationships • Anger, fear, panic, stress, shyness, confusion, helplessness, guilt • Suicide and self harm • Obsessive or compulsive thoughts and actions • Problems with identity, existence, parents or children While these categories signify common factors in suffering, every psychoanalysis is unique.
johncameron.specialties: Dissociative Disorders, Gender and Sexuality, Psychosexual

weiyuguan.name: Weiyu Guan
weiyuguan.title: Art Therapist, Psychotherapist
weiyuguan.description: I work from a deep trust in human connection and in the ever-present web of nature that supports us. I value clients as the artist in their own life, and I am committed to walking alongside each person with curiosity, respect, compassion and presence.
weiyuguan.specialties: Dissociative Disorders, Gender and Sexuality, PTSD, Trauma Recovery, Trauma-Informed

christophermether.name: Christopher Mether
christophermether.title: Psychoanalyst, Counsellor
christophermether.description: Chris is a practicing psychoanalyst with the Australian Centre for Psychoanalysis. He provides a non-judgemental space where both conscious and unconscious thoughts can be explored. His exhibitions presented stories of immigration which often involved loss, trauma and notions of identity.

danielamiszkinis.name: Daniela Miszkinis
danielamiszkinis.title: Art Therapist, Clinical Supervisor
danielamiszkinis.description: I am a Holistic Counsellor with specialisation in Art Therapy (Master of Art Therapy, La Trobe Uni, ANZACATA) and Clinical Counselling & Supervision (ACA). I am an officially registered NDIS Provider. In my integrative and creative practice, I work on my client's self-esteem by affirming their dignity and self-worth, providing emotional outlets and an opportunity to express oneself in a way that is safe and contained, especially when accessing traumatic material. I specialise in trauma-informed care.
danielamiszkinis.specialties: Dissociative Disorders, PTSD, Sexual Abuse, Trauma Recovery, Trauma-Informed

paulreid.name: Paul Reid
paulreid.title: Psychotherapist, Psychoanalytic Psychotherapist
paulreid.description: Although we have specific words and labels for many of the difficulties and forms of suffering that we all experience, these labels and terms have little positive effect on these forms of mental and emotional suffering. Through the psychoanalytic process, I can help you to find a way to work through the difficulties that you maybe experiencing. This might including your talking about your initial difficulties but also your fears, desires, sexual life, dreams, relationships and concerns.

jo-ellenwhite.name: Jo-Ellen White
jo-ellenwhite.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
jo-ellenwhite.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: LGBTIQA+, Trauma.

jodeevella.name: Jodee Vella
jodeevella.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
jodeevella.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: LGBTIQA+, Trauma.

jodiejohnson.name: Jodie Johnson
jodiejohnson.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
jodiejohnson.description: I am a registered counsellor with the Australian Counselling Association (Level 2). My counselling qualifications include a Diploma of Counselling (Uniting Institute of Education) and a Graduate Diploma in Counselling (UNE). I am trauma informed and support mental health wellbeing and resilience.

johnwindschuttle.name: John Windschuttle
johnwindschuttle.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
johnwindschuttle.description: I’m a psychotherapist and counsellor with seven years’ experience, working with trauma (including PTSD), phobias, anxiety, self-esteem, entrenched emotional and relationship patterns, men’s issues, and LGBTQ+ clients. You might be dealing with past trauma, or recognise aspects of yourself that need attention, clarity, and healing. I use a trauma-informed approach with EMDR, Flash Technique, CBT, Deep Looking, and person-centred therapy in a safe, respectful environment.

joselynbrown.name: Joselyn Brown
joselynbrown.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
joselynbrown.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: LGBTIQA+.

joshuasamuels.name: Joshua Samuels
joshuasamuels.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
joshuasamuels.description: My therapeutic approach is collaborative, insight-driven, client centered, compassionate, non-judgemental, and holistic focused on helping clients reconnect with themselves and grounded in a holistic understanding of wellbeing, addressing not only presenting symptoms, but also the underlying patterns contributing to distress. I worked with a wide range of client needs and complex presentations, supporting individuals with diverse goals, diagnoses, and life circumstances. I believe that life’s challenges can be opportunities for insight and growth, and that through greater self-awareness, people can build deeper intimacy and move forward with clarity and purpose.

junkofukuhara.name: Junko Fukuhara
junkofukuhara.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 3)
junkofukuhara.description: Hello, I'm Junko, a registered counsellor who speaks Japanese and English. I work with adults and couples to help them with mood-related issues, eating disorders, relationship issues, domestic violence/abuse and grief associated with crimes and scams. If you have private insurance like Bupa or ARHG, you may be able to get a rebate to cover a session/s with me.

charliesnowball.name: Charlie Snowball
charliesnowball.title: Counsellor, Holistic Counsellor
charliesnowball.description: I’m a holistic, trauma-informed psychotherapist who supports women who are ready to understand themselves more deeply, break old patterns, and heal the parts of their past that still feel heavy. Many of the women I work with grew up in environments where they had to be strong, independent, or emotionally self-reliant, and now struggle with anxiety, relationship stress, identity shifts, people-pleasing, or low self-worth. My approach is warm, collaborative, and trauma-informed. I draw from person-centred therapy, Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), and mindfulness, while also integrating body-based practices and trauma-informed yoga to help you reconnect with yourself on a deeper level. Every session is tailored to your needs, whether you are seeking to heal from past trauma, build healthier relationships, or feel more connected in your daily life.
charliesnowball.specialties: Dissociative Disorders, Sexual Abuse, Trauma Recovery, Trauma Sensitive Yoga, Trauma-Informed

felicityahern.name: Felicity Ahern
felicityahern.title: Counsellor, Psychotherapist
felicityahern.description: I am a PACFA registered counsellor with forest therapy training and a background in holistic treatments such as reiki and meditation. I am skilled in ACT (Acceptance and Commitment Therapy) and have an extensive background in mental health work with complex conditions such as schizophrenia, psychosis and acute depression and anxiety.
felicityahern.specialties: Gender and Sexuality, Trauma Recovery, Trauma-Informed

nicoleday.name: Nicole Day
nicoleday.title: Counsellor, Relationship Therapist
nicoleday.description: Nicole views therapy as a collaborative process built on trust, openness, and mutual respect. Nicole supports clients from the age of 10+ years, with a special interest in adolescence, and neuro-diversity.
nicoleday.specialties: Gender and Sexuality, Trauma Recovery, Trauma-Informed

jeanneneeastaway.name: Jeannene Eastaway
jeanneneeastaway.title: Counsellor, Relationship Therapist
jeanneneeastaway.description: Of all the theories I have studied and practiced it’s wrapping it all up in a metaphorical ‘blanket of compassion’ that works best. In my life and practice I have chosen a compassionate response to myself and the ‘other’ to create a learning environment for change and growth.
jeanneneeastaway.specialties: Gender and Sexuality, Sexual Abuse, Trauma Recovery, Trauma-Informed

katherinebarber.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
katherinebarber.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: LGBTIQA+, Trauma.

kathleenbrennan.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
kathleenbrennan.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: LGBTIQA+, Trauma.

kellywalker.name: Kelly Walker
kellywalker.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
kellywalker.description: Some of the most meaningful moments in therapy don't happen when someone learns a new coping strategy. I have a particular interest in neurodivergent children, adolescents and women, developmental trauma, emotional wellbeing, identity, parent-child relationships and the ways our environments shape our capacity to thrive. I particularly enjoy supporting clinicians working with neurodivergent clients, developmental trauma, parent work, play therapy and private practice.

kirsten.name: Kirsten .
kirsten.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
kirsten.description: Conversations in Nature is a counselling service based in Melbourne, Australia, founded by Kirsten, an ACA Level 4 Counsellor. Therapeutic counselling services across Australia, specialising in areas such as grief and loss, suicide bereavement, childhood trauma and healing from family violence. My counselling is based on compassionate, person-centred, client led approach to mental health and well-being, integrating nature and somatic practices such as trauma-informed yoga, Psycho-Education.

kirstenbakker.name: Kirsten Bakker
kirstenbakker.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
kirstenbakker.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: LGBTIQA+, Trauma.

laurabartal.name: Laura Bartal
laurabartal.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
laurabartal.description: Laura is an ACA accredited counsellor and neurodivergent specialist based on the Mornington Peninsula, offering in-person sessions and Telehealth across Australia. With postgraduate qualifications in counselling, child and adolescent mental health, and a Masters in Autism and Neurodivergence, alongside over two decades of experience in leadership, executive coaching, and organisational consulting, Laura brings both specialist clinical training and real-world depth to her practice. Lumina Therapy specialises in working with neurodivergent individuals, couples, and families.

tessalancashire.name: Tessa Lancashire
tessalancashire.title: Psychotherapist, Psychodynamic Psychotherapist
tessalancashire.description: It can be hard to consider coming to therapy… You might be experiencing chronic pain or recurring physical symptoms. Perhaps you are exhausted and you feel like you have already tried everything. Maybe you are worried or overwhelmed by the relationships in your life.

riznaplunkett.name: Rizna Plunkett
riznaplunkett.title: Integrative Psychotherapist, Soul Centred Psychotherapist
riznaplunkett.description: Rizna (she/they) is a non-binary & queer Integrative Psychotherapist, Youth Worker and Grief-tender. Their therapeutic approach is gentle, collaborative, rooted in cultural humility, grounded in a steady slowness that rests in curiousity, which aims to respect each person’s lived experience, intergenerational trauma and ancestral history that we all carry.
riznaplunkett.specialties: Gender and Sexuality, PTSD, Sex Related Issues, Sexual Abuse, Trauma Recovery, Trauma-Informed

tanyarae.name: Tanya Rae
tanyarae.title: Counsellor, Hypnotherapist
tanyarae.description: I believe that therapy is a space where you can explore yourself without the pressure to be fixed. My vision is to create a supportive environment where you can learn, question, express and reflect, at your own pace.
tanyarae.specialties: Gender and Sexuality, Trauma Recovery, Trauma-Informed

pacoromeusoler.name: Paco Romeu Soler
pacoromeusoler.title: Social Worker AMHSW, Psychoanalyst
pacoromeusoler.description: In my practice, each person is met with a deep commitment to listening to the singularity of their experience. Psychoanalysis, as I practice it, offers a calm and collaborative space where you can speak openly about your concerns and difficulties. Prior to working full-time in private practice, I worked for over a decade across diverse clinical settings, including acute adult mental health services, community mental health programs, drug and alcohol services, LGBTIQA+ health support programs, sexual assault services, and SASH at the Royal Children’s Hospital. I also have extensive experience supporting individuals from LGBTIQ+ communities.
pacoromeusoler.specialties: Gender and Sexuality, PTSD, Sex Related Issues, Sexual Abuse, Trauma Recovery, Trauma-Informed
