lisakavvadias.description: Dance of The Mind is an invitation to explore the self, not as something to fix or control, but something to explore, witness and discern with grace, safety and compassion. Our internal landscape is alive and relational; shaped by the body, informed by experience and expressed through movement, story and sensation deserving curiosity and care.

juliasymons.name: Julia Symons
juliasymons.title: Psychologist
juliasymons.description: I'm a caring and compassionate psychologist with many years of counselling experience. My focus is centred on creating a safe and collaborative therapeutic relationship, in which you can feel comfortable to express what you need to, including those things that may be difficult to say.
juliasymons.specialties: Gender and Sexuality, Trauma Recovery, Trauma-Informed

blakedavis.name: Blake Davis
blakedavis.title: Psychoanalyst, Psychologist
blakedavis.description: Blake takes a humanistic approach in his work, respecting each individual's dignity, agency, and experiences. He aims to foster a safe and productive therapeutic relationship, where your concerns can be heard, understood, and addressed. He is a clinical psychology registrar with experience working with clients across the lifespan, including those from diverse backgrounds, experiencing anxiety, behavioural difficulties, panic attacks, trauma, depression, attentional and hyperactivity concerns, and difficulties related to autism.
blakedavis.specialties: PTSD, Sex Related Issues, Trauma Recovery, Trauma-Informed

adamgrosman.name: Adam Grosman
adamgrosman.title: Counsellor, Somatic Psychotherapist
adamgrosman.description: I believe that your body and mind are working from the same place. I am very curious about how your relationships and life have affected the way your mind and body are organised. My expertise is in working both verbally and physically so that you can re-evaluate your relationship to yourself and decide what works for you, and what doesn't.

elenikidis.name: Eleni Kidis
elenikidis.title: Social Worker, Relationship Therapist
elenikidis.description: Therapy is a process that takes time, true commitment and above all, a courageous heart! Disentangling psycho-emotional wounds brings up discomfort and distress. As a therapist, I guide you through this process and reassure you that healing happens when you are able to go deep within yourself; that you have innate wisdom within you that has been covered by the thick dust of your traumas and hurts. spent the first part of my Social Work career working in health and community services, in various roles including; counselling, family therapy, project management, mental health and physical health promotion, women’s health women’s services and the sexual assault/family violence fields. It explores hidden trans-generational family dynamics, traumas, secrets, and exclusions that can cause emotional entanglements and disruptive attachment patterns.
elenikidis.specialties: PTSD, Sex Related Issues, Sexual Abuse, Trauma Recovery, Trauma Sensitive Yoga, Trauma-Informed

sararaby.name: Sara Raby
sararaby.title: Psychologist
sararaby.description: I’m Sara, a Melbourne psychologist working with adolescents and adults navigating anxiety, depression, burnout, grief, life transitions, and relationship challenges — including the complex shifts of pregnancy, postpartum, and parenthood. People often arrive feeling overwhelmed, stuck, or unsure how to move forward. Alongside this foundation, I integrate EMDR, Schema Therapy, DBT, and CBT where they’re most suited to the person in front of me. I work with clients across a range of presentations including anxiety, depression, trauma, burnout, grief, life transitions, and relationship difficulties.
sararaby.specialties: PTSD, Sexual Abuse, Trauma Recovery, EMDR, Schema Therapy, Trauma-Informed

arnastewart.name: Arna Stewart
arnastewart.title: Clinical Psychologist, Clinical Supervisor
arnastewart.description: I am not currently taking new clients. I work part-time with individual adults. I have over 20 years of experience in working with trauma, grief and loss, depression and anxiety. I first worked as a psychologist in private practice in country Victoria and then moved to Melbourne where I worked for 18 years with refugee and asylum seeker survivors of torture and trauma. psychodynamic, CBT, EMDR and schema therapy.
arnastewart.specialties: PTSD, Sexual Abuse, Trauma Recovery, EMDR, Schema Therapy, Trauma-Informed

juliaagnoletto.name: Julia Agnoletto
juliaagnoletto.title: Clinical Psychologist
juliaagnoletto.description: Therapy is a space for reflection, growth, and meaningful change. I take a collaborative and practical approach, helping clients make sense of their experiences, build useful skills, and move toward a more balanced and fulfilling life. I use evidence-based therapies, including Cognitive Behavioural Therapy, Exposure and Response Prevention, Acceptance and Commitment Therapy, Schema Therapy, and Emotion-Focused Therapy, to help you gain insight, develop coping strategies, and create lasting change. I take a neuroaffirming and LGBTQIA+ affirming approach, recognising the diverse ways people experience the world.

joshuacomyn.name: Joshua Comyn
joshuacomyn.title: Psychotherapist
joshuacomyn.description: My work is grounded in three commitments: understanding your own experience with real clarity, working with what moves beneath conscious awareness, and loosening the grip of the stories we tell about who we are. I trained as an integrative psychotherapist and think about the mind through a psychodynamic, attachment-based lens, drawing on thinkers who root psychoanalytic theory in the neurobiology of relationship and affect regulation.
joshuacomyn.specialties: PTSD, Trauma Recovery, Schema Therapy, Trauma-Informed

makakhiwemasuku.name: Makakhiwe Masuku
makakhiwemasuku.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
makakhiwemasuku.description: Hello and Welcome, I am Makakhiwe “Mak” (they/them) is a Psychotherapist and Counsellor, Facilitator, and advocator for healing. With several years of experience in the community sector providing trauma-informed and culturally responsive therapeutic care. I specialise in supporting individuals and families through anxiety and depression, trauma, grief and loss, relationship breakdowns and family violence, systems and racial challenges, and shifting family dynamics. Whether you're navigating life experiences, trauma, grief, neurodivergence, I hold space for your story with care, curiosity, and compassion.

marianaraquelhahir.name: Mariana Raquel Hahir
marianaraquelhahir.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
marianaraquelhahir.description: Mariana Hahir Clinical Counselling Services is dedicated to providing a safe and supportive environment for individuals seeking counselling and psychotherapy. Our goal is to help clients navigate through life's challenges and empower them to achieve personal growth and mental well-being. We offer a range of counselling services, including individual, adult and child counselling and psychotherapy, based on Client-Centred Therapy, Psychodynamic Therapy, Dialectical Behavioural Therapy (DBT) and Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT), Trauma and Grief Therapy from a trauma informed perspective, and Attachment Theory in Clinical Practice to support clients through various life transitions and emotional difficulties.

marilynvaccaro.name: Marilyn Vaccaro
marilynvaccaro.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
marilynvaccaro.description: SHEvolution Space Online Counselling SHEvolution Space offers holistic, online counselling for women and LGBTQIA+ individuals seeking clarity, emotional balance, and meaningful personal growth. This is a calm, confidential space where you are supported to explore what may be holding you back, work through challenges, and move toward a more grounded, aligned version of yourself. Sessions are tailored to you, focusing on uncovering limiting patterns, strengthening self-awareness, and building practical emotional tools to support your wellbeing, relationships, and day-to-day life.

marissamallari.name: Marissa Mallari
marissamallari.title: Counsellor (ACA Proficient)
marissamallari.description: Marissa is a dedicated and compassionate Counsellor with a passion for helping individuals navigate life's challenges. She has honed her skills in providing empathetic and non-judgmental support to those seeking guidance on their journey toward mental and emotional well-being. Marissa completed her undergraduate degree in Psychology in Canada, concluding her studies through the Counselling Masters program at Monash University.

christopherhalden.name: Christine Halden
christopherhalden.title: Psychologist
christopherhalden.description: I’m a psychologist who blends evidence-based approaches with real-world compassion to help clients sharpen their skills, deepen their self-awareness, and reconnect with purpose. I often work with people who are over-functioning or seem like they're functioning well but want to improve their emotional intelligence, leadership, relationships, and life direction. I create a warm, collaborative space that honours complexity—whether you’re navigating personal growth, trauma recovery, chronic pain, or attachment dynamics. My approach integrates CBT, schema therapy, ACT, and somatic awareness, tailored to your goals.

clairenaidoo.name: Claire Naidoo
clairenaidoo.title: Clinical Psychologist
clairenaidoo.description: I offer a warm, relational space where you can feel deeply seen, understood, and safe to explore what’s happening beneath the surface. I believe meaningful change comes through insight, emotional connection, and a strong therapeutic relationship, alongside supporting your nervous system to feel more regulated and grounded. I work with adults navigating trauma, emotional intensity, life transitions, and questions of identity — often people who are high-functioning on the outside but struggling internally. I then moved into psychology and have since worked across public and private mental health settings with adults experiencing trauma, personality difficulties, anxiety, and highly complex presentations, including psychosis.
clairenaidoo.specialties: PTSD, Sexual Abuse, Trauma Recovery, EMDR, Trauma-Informed

kristasenden.name: Krista Senden
kristasenden.title: Social Worker, Counsellor
kristasenden.description: Guided by a strong commitment to social justice and human dignity, I have worked extensively with people seeking support with trauma, mental health concerns and difficult life circumstances. I have developed strong expertise in working with complex trauma, grief, depression, anxiety, emotional distress and the impact of prolonged stress. These experiences deepened my understanding of how trauma, loss and prolonged stress can shape people’s lives. I have worked for many years within specialist trauma and grief services in Australia. I have developed strong expertise in working with complex trauma, grief, depression, mental health conditions, emotional distress, and the impact of prolonged stress.

vanessawylie.name: Vanessa Wylie
vanessawylie.title: Counsellor, Relationship Therapist
vanessawylie.description: I’m a relationship-focused therapist supporting individuals and couples to navigate complicated relationships and reconnect with themselves and others. Many of my clients feel stuck, overwhelmed or disconnected, often facing betrayal, separation, parenting stress or life transitions.

My approach is collaborative, trauma-informed and values-led, constructing safe spaces for children and young people to share honestly, be seen, and navigate challenges. I specialise in work with young people facing school refusal, neurodivergent folks, and LGBTQIA+ clients, with over five years of professional experience (as well as my own lived experience of queerness, disability and autism) to support the work.

We also provide specialised support to young people in care, who have had contact with the youth justice system or those who have experienced trauma and attachment disruption.

As a counsellor since 2008, I understand that life can be challenging sometimes, and we can lose our way in it. I treat my clients with warmth, empathy, and unconditional support, giving them the space and confidence that they need to walk through the pains of their growth and once again find their love for their true self. https://www.psychologytoday.com/au/counselling/brand-counselling-services-bentleigh-east-vic/1061033

I work with adults during challenging times, offering a supportive space to regain stability, strengthen day to day functioning, and rebuild a sense of direction and identity. My approach is integrative, meaning I draw flexibly on evidence-based therapies combining person-centred, relational, cognitive behavioural, narrative and mindfulness based approaches.

pattyarceri.name: Patty Arceri
pattyarceri.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
pattyarceri.description: Welcome. I'm Patty from The Inner Growth Journey. You may be managing life as best you can, yet still feel anxious, emotionally overwhelmed, or uncertain about where things are heading.

alexinabaldini.name: Alexina Baldini
alexinabaldini.title: Psychologist, Clinical Supervisor
alexinabaldini.description: Alexina assists individuals and organisations to realise their true potential through the provision of innovative clinical, consultative, and training services. My aim is to translate psychological knowledge and research into exemplary service delivery that realises potential by: creating opportunities for personal growth and development, encouraging positive personal and workplace relationships, developing opportunities for company growth and diversity. I am passionate about empowering individuals and families to live the life they dream of and particularly specialise in trauma recovery, forensic and workplace arenas and child, adolescent and family interests.

penelopelovegrove.name: Penelope Lovegrove
penelopelovegrove.title: Psychologist, Counsellor
penelopelovegrove.description: Penelope is an accredited psychologist and experienced therapist who has worked with individuals of varying ages across a range of concerns. She is passionate about the practice of psychotherapy as a powerful tool for emotional healing and personal growth. Penelope has undertaken additional training in CBT, ACT, Internal Family Systems, Schema Therapy, Solution Focused and Compassion-Focused Therapy.

emmaschubert.name: Emma Schubert
emmaschubert.title: Clinical Psychologist
emmaschubert.description: Hi there, I’m Emma. I am a clinical psychologist working with both children and adults.

arthurstabolidis.name: Dr Arthur Stabolidis
arthurstabolidis.title: Clinical Psychologist, Psychotherapist
arthurstabolidis.description: I adopt a compassionate and empathic forward-focused approach to therapy. I believe that cultivating empathy for yourself and others, the ability to regulate emotions, and a robust stress management routine are essential elements in personal, social and career success.

lorettabell.name: Dr Loretta Bell
lorettabell.title: Clinical Psychologist, Relationship Therapist
lorettabell.description: I like to work in a collaborative process in which therapy fits the person or couple I am seeing. I work integratively from a wealth of theories and counselling modalities that I have mastered over my years as a therapist. I am also training in schema therapy and Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR).
lorettabell.specialties: PTSD, Trauma Recovery, EMDR, Schema Therapy, Trauma-Informed

Bec’s work is trauma-informed, prioritising her clients’ sense of safety and readiness to engage. Bec enjoys supporting adolescents and adults who may be experiencing issues such as low mood, anxiety, navigating life transitions, grief and loss, low self-esteem and confidence, attachment or relational difficulties and work/school-related stress.

Whether you're experiencing anxiety, stress, burnout, relationship challenges, ADHD, autism, trauma, women's wellbeing concerns, life transitions, or simply feeling stuck, I provide a safe, non-judgemental space where we can work together towards greater wellbeing and resilience. My approach is person-centred, trauma-informed, and strengths-based, recognising that every person's story is unique.

My passion lies in providing a listening ear, offering encouragement, and creating a safe debriefing space for you. Guiding you through the journey of unfolding, rediscovering innate wisdom, and reconnecting with your uniquely beautiful self is what drives me.

sallytanner.name: Sally Tanner
sallytanner.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
sallytanner.description: From the outside, it may look like you're holding it all together - "coping fine." While on the inside it feels things are starting to unravel. You may be feeling disconnected, anxious, overwhelmed, frustrated, exhausted, or simply unsure how to move forward. My approach is collaborative, trauma-informed and genuinely non-judgemental.

samanthalehmann.name: Samantha Lehmann
samanthalehmann.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
samanthalehmann.description: Hi, I’m Samantha Payne, M.A.C.A. (Level 1), Registered Counsellor and founder of The Connection Room. I believe that meaningful change begins when people feel genuinely heard, understood and accepted.

sandeepadnani.name: Sandeep Adnani
sandeepadnani.title: Counsellor (ACA International)
sandeepadnani.description: I am a professional counsellor providing online counselling in Australia, specializing in grief and loss , child parenting, relationship & conflict management and issues related to anxiety, stress, self-esteem, life transitions and decision-making, and an International member of the Australian Counselling Association (ACA). I am a multi-lingual individual, having lived in four different countries and experienced various different cultures, my life experience and qualifications have given me a sound understanding of human interactions and patterns. I easily identify and address issues and concerns, putting people at ease with my calm, attentive approach.

sandrabest.name: Sandra Best
sandrabest.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
sandrabest.description: At Juniper Tree Counselling, I specialise in couples counselling and provide dedicated support for parents and caregivers of individuals with ASD, ADHD and other neurodevelopmental disorders. I also offer guidance and support for those living with or caring for loved ones facing mental health challenges. I am here to help you navigate relationship dynamics and personal growth.

laurabattley.name: Laura Battley
laurabattley.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
laurabattley.description: Laura Battley, MSc, GDip.Psych(Adv) professional journey is deeply intertwined with her roles as a mother, creative, and clinical psychotherapist. With a profound understanding of the interconnectedness between mind, body, spirit, and soul, Laura's practice spans a spectrum of modalities, ranging from traditional psychotherapy to innovative transpersonal arts therapy and contemporary shamanic practices. As a compassionate guide, Laura leads individuals on transformative journeys of self-discovery, healing, and empowerment.
laurabattley.specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy

kymanderton.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
kymanderton.description: Kym has been a therapist for 25 years, initially as a Myotherapist, transitioning to psychotherapy and counselling to support individuals and couples to navigate life's challenges, mentally and emotionally. Kym draws from integrative approaches such as Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), Attachment Repair, Somatic Experiencing, Trauma Informed Therapy, and other relevant models. Her approach caters to clients with stress, anxiety, depression, relationship disturbances, self-esteem issues, the impact of abuse, trauma, grief and loss, addiction, and other presenting problems.
kymanderton.specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy

laurasolis.description: Welcome. I practice with an integrative, humanistic, holistic, existential and trauma informed approach. I work with trauma, anxiety, depression, life transitions, grief & loss, relationship concerns, existential concerns, overwhelm.
laurasolis.specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

aljeffery.name: Al Jeffery
aljeffery.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
aljeffery.description: Al is an integrative psychotherapist aiming to create spaces of trust for clients to explore the intricacy and fullness of their own lives and minds, coming to a greater sense of resilience and compassion within themselves, and their world. Using a collaborative, relational, embodied, and integrative approach, Al has experience supporting clients living with; depression, anxiety, grief and loss, relationship challenges, emotional and relationship disturbance. ashleykarstunen.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
ashleykarstunen.description: If you're carrying the weight of trauma, facing anxiety or grief, seeking LGBTQ+ affirming support, or exploring purpose and belonging, you're not alone. I'm Ashley Karstunen, a Registered Clinical Counsellor, Depth therapist, and Trauma-Informed EFT Practitioner specializing in trauma recovery, anxiety treatment, and somatic therapy approaches that honor your whole self. Clinical Specialisations: • Trauma Therapy using Process-Oriented Psychotherapy and somatic approaches • Trauma-Informed EFT (Emotional Freedom Techniques) for rapid emotional regulation • Anxiety and Depression treatment through nervous system regulation • LGBTQ+ Affirming Therapy that celebrates authentic identity • Grief and Loss counselling with compassion and mindfulness integration. Therapeutic Approach: Since 2017, I've supported clients through PTSD recovery, life transitions, identity exploration, and feeling stuck or unfulfilled. My practice integrates Trauma-Informed EFT, Process-Oriented Psychology, mindfulness practices, and somatic interventions to create personalized treatment that addresses root causes rather than just symptoms.
ashleykarstunen.specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

She integrates a range of treatment modalities into her work and always uses a trauma-informed and anti-oppressive lens. *Sophie is currently offering online sessions.*

My lived experience being queer, trans, neurodivergent and POC informs my work, seeing me embrace an anti-oppressive, de-colonising, intersectional feminist and queer lens. I enjoy working with the LGBTIQA+ community, people questioning their sexuality and or gender identity and allies. I have several years professional experience working as a Counsellor at a community health organisation that specialises in working with the LGBTIQ+ community and people living with and affected by HIV.

hughmartin.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
hughmartin.description: Family problems from trivial to severe will challenge every family at some point. Family Therapy can feel like a real life saver, whether it’s adjusting to the teenage years, divorce, separation, managing conflict respectfully or grieving. Family members seek my help when they become stuck in repeating patterns of hurtful or harmful behaviour and have run out of ideas for solving problems.
hughmartin.specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues

iuliiakapinos.name: Iuliia Kapinos
iuliiakapinos.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
iuliiakapinos.description: Think of me as a friendly guide on a journey to understand your feelings. Life can sometimes be puzzling, and it's perfectly okay to seek help. As humans, we all have feelings, and it's important to take care of them.
iuliiakapinos.specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

joannegniel.name: Joanne Gniel
joannegniel.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
joannegniel.description: Jo Gniel (she/her) is a certified Emotionally Focused Therapist (EFT) and Supervisor in training and a trained teacher of Mindful Self-Compassion. She is the founder of landscape of life; dedicated to building human connection; helping people create healthy relationships and wellbeing in all aspects of life. As a relationship counsellor and psychotherapist, Jo integrates the paradigms and practices of modern psychology and neuroscience, Western relational psychology and Eastern contemplative practice to help individuals, couples and families develop a better understanding of themselves and others, navigate the challenges and transitions of life and make the changes they want in life.
joannegniel.specialties: Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery

katherinehorne.name: Kate Horne
katherinehorne.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
katherinehorne.description: I am currently seeing clients in-person adjoining the beautiful forest of the Dandenong Ranges near Melbourne, and online. 'As you are, you are welcome' is the invisible sign above my therapy room door. I welcome clients of diverse ability, age, culture, ethnicity, faith, gender, gender identity, relationship structure and sexuality. “The purpose of a human being is to participate in the flourishing of life” – Charles Eisenstein
katherinehorne.specialties: Sex and sexual issues, Somatic psychotherapy

katherinezammit.name: Kate Zammit
katherinezammit.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
katherinezammit.description: As a Gestalt Psychotherapist, I feel genuinely grateful to do work that I love and feel both humbled and honoured to sit with people during some of their most vulnerable and authentic moments. My psychotherapy practice in Carlton and Essendon is informed not only by my professional training but also by my own lived experience of a personal therapeutic journey. I understand what it’s like to sit on the other side of the room, and I have a deep appreciation for how difficult it can feel at times.

sallycooper.name: Sally Cooper
sallycooper.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
sallycooper.practice: Sally Cooper Consulting Group Pty Ltd
sallycooper.description: Areas listed on PACFA profile: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery.

deehenry.name: Dee Henry
deehenry.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
deehenry.description: Dee is a registered counsellor, she has many years of experience working with marginalised groups in the human rights and community sector. Dee provides individual counselling to adolescents and adults, relationship counselling and family counselling. She is passionate about supporting people through experiences with anxiety, depression, trauma, life transitions and relationship issues.

jessicaruschen.name: Jessica Ruschen
jessicaruschen.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
jessicaruschen.description: I am passionate about empowering people to prosper in life. I pride myself on building secure, comfortable connections with my clients, as I have seen over and over that a strong therapeutic relationship is the precursor to lasting growth. I have a strengths based approach to therapy that is grounded in evidence-based practices, including Acceptance & Commitment Therapy (ACT), Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT), Schema Therapy, Solution Focused Brief Therapy (SFBT) and mindfulness-based interventions.

charlene.name: Charlene Ma
charlene.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
charlene.description: Are you feeling overwhelmed by anxiety, sadness, or self-doubt, even when you're trying your best to keep things together? Perhaps you feel a deep sense that something is out of balance, and you're longing for inner peace and more fulfilling relationships. My approach is relational, trauma-informed, and tailored uniquely to your needs.

rhiannongill.name: Rhiannon Gill
rhiannongill.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
rhiannongill.description: At Express Yourself Counselling, we provide a safe space for you to express your feelings and thoughts. We specialise in working with children and adults, to help positively promote their mental health and wellbeing. We are located in Parkdale, and our compassionate team is here to support you through life's challenges with understanding and empathy.
rhiannongill.specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

debrabattersby.name: Debra Battersby
debrabattersby.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
debrabattersby.description: Hello, thanks for visiting. My name is Debra and Heart Life Counselling is a counselling service for adults (16+), individual and couples, that also has a special interest in supporting recovery from trauma & abuse. Over the years I have pursued a particular interest and expertise in anxiety and trauma work, depression, anxiety, recovery from past abuse, and relationship stresses including recovery from domestic violence.

angebishop.name: Ange Bishop
angebishop.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
angebishop.description: As a registered psychotherapist and counsellor, I help people make sense of their thoughts, feelings, and the world around them to bring improvements to their psychological wellbeing. Whatever brings you to therapy, I will meet you with openness, honesty and respect. I currently see clients from a private practice in South Yarra, and online, providing a confidential, non-judgemental space.

clairespicer.name: Claire Spicer
clairespicer.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
clairespicer.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: LGBTIQA+, Transgender affirming care, Trauma.

cristinajimenez.name: Cristina Jimenez
cristinajimenez.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 3)
cristinajimenez.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: LGBTIQA+, Sex Therapy, Transgender affirming care, Trauma.
cristinajimenez.specialties: LGBTIQA+, Sex Therapy, Transgender affirming care, Trauma

danakabaila.name: Dana Kabaila
danakabaila.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
danakabaila.description: Dana (she/her) is a lived-experience neurodivergent counsellor and narrative therapist based in Naarm/Melbourne. Dana has experience supporting client's exploring: gender expansiveness, sexuality and neuro-queer identity childhood, familial and trans-generational trauma chronic illness, fatigue and/or pain meltdowns, shut downs, burn out and recovery substance use suicidal thoughts (sometimes described as singing your death song) Narrative Therapy training grounds Dana's work in a First Nation's social justice framework. She has specialised training in Persistent Drive for Autonomy (previously Pathological Demand Avoidance), Rejection Sensitivity Dysphoria, Situational Non-speaking (clinically labelled Selective Mutism), restricted diet and mealtime difficulties, and trans and gender expansive voice identity coaching. Dana's experience working with children contributes to a nurturing approach to the young parts held in the stories of adults.
danakabaila.specialties: LGBTIQA+, Sex Therapy, Transgender affirming care, Trauma

danielgray.name: Daniel Gray
danielgray.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
danielgray.description: Hi there, I'm Daniel, a registered counsellor offering counselling services in Brisbane, Melbourne and online. I apply a non-judgemental, person-centred counselling style to create a safe, confidential space for people to speak freely and explore their concerns. My areas of expertise are gender and sexuality affirming care, addiction, and integrating psychedelic and altered state experiences.

danielapetrovic.name: Daniela Petrovic
danielapetrovic.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
danielapetrovic.description: ​At Soul Village Therapy, I work with sensitive, deep-feeling individuals to address chronic stress, anxiety, depression, self esteem and relationship issues. I draw from Focusing-oriented therapy, somatic experiencing, and trauma-informed and relational attachment theory to provide an integrative approach. I'm especially attuned to how trauma lives in the body and how to bring the nervous system back to equilibrium - creating inner-harmony.

seamusmullins.name: Seamus Mullins
seamusmullins.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
seamusmullins.description: Confidential and affordable therapy online, from a Melbourne based Australian counsellor, specialising in individual, grief and loss, and ADHD counselling.

seanmenere.name: Sean Menere
seanmenere.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
seanmenere.description: If you think things could be better, you're probably right. It's hard to ignore that voice inside us that's looking for the right person to help us take the first steps. I specialise in working with anyone facing challenges including, but not limited to: - depression, - anxiety, - stress and anger management, - relationship difficulties/divorce, - major life transitions, - trauma, - abuse, - grief and loss, - illness and major injury, I know how helpful it is to have someone who not only understands, but has both the personal experience with what it takes to get to a place where 'better' is an option, combined with the professional expertise to get you there.

sharaniveenrajabdeen.name: Shara Niveen Rajabdeen
sharaniveenrajabdeen.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
sharaniveenrajabdeen.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: LGBTIQA+, Trauma.

srividyaravichandran.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: LGBTIQA+, Trauma.

stephanieschiftan.name: Stephanie Schiftan
stephanieschiftan.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
stephanieschiftan.description: I'm a specialist couples and relationship therapist based in Melbourne, holding a Master of Counselling (Couples Stream) and advanced training in integrative couple therapy through Relationships Australia. Before becoming a therapist, I worked extensively in education and hold a Bachelor of Fine Arts. I work with couples at all stages and warmly welcome LGBTQI+ clients and diverse relationship structures.

susanguzick.name: Susan Guzick
susanguzick.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
susanguzick.description: Hello, I’m Sue. People I work with include those who have complex experiences of depression, PTSD, neurodiversity, social anxiety, family violence, trauma, chronic physical conditions, cognition and memory impacts, personality disorders, schizophrenia, hoarding experiences, alcohol or drug use, and isolation. My qualifications include the Master of Art Therapy (integrated Counselling), Dip of Mental Health, ongoing Master of Counselling, and specialised training with complex mental health and trauma. Evidence-base methods can include Interpersonal Therapy, Acceptance and Commitment Therapy, Trauma / Poly-Vagal Theory, Internal Family Systems, and Art Therapy Expressive methods.

susannemcallister.name: Susanne McAllister
susannemcallister.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
susannemcallister.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: LGBTIQA+, Trauma.

tailahwalker-cuman.name: Tailah Walker-Cuman
tailahwalker-cuman.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
tailahwalker-cuman.description: Tailah Cuman is a holistic counsellor specialising in emotional neglect. She has traveled internationally delivering workshops on emotions, movement and the nervous system. Her clientele generally consists of people under 40 who have experienced varying degrees of emotional neglect or developmental trauma, and whom have tried regular psychology or counselling but have not seen the mental, emotional and spiritual relief they are after.

taniadionisio.name: Tania Dionisio
taniadionisio.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
taniadionisio.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: LGBTIQA+, Trauma.

thomasreiner.name: Thomas Reiner
thomasreiner.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
thomasreiner.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: LGBTIQA+.

timfraser.name: Tim Fraser
timfraser.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
timfraser.description: I support clients with a range of issues, but I am particularly focused on the role of attachment and how developing a secure attachment style can help heal various issues. I completed a Graduate Diploma in psychology at the University of Melbourne, then trained in integrative Psychotherapy at the Ikon institute of Australia. I’ve studied mentalisation-based therapy, different meta-cognitive therapies, and Psychodynamic Interpersonal Therapy (The Conversational Model), but I also frequently draw on Internal Family Systems, somatic experiencing, and cognitive-behavioural therapy.

timothylambert.name: Timothy Lambert
timothylambert.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
timothylambert.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: LGBTIQA+.

tracyguy.name: Tracy Guy
tracyguy.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
tracyguy.description: I am a registered counsellor with a strong background in mental health, trauma support, and complex care environments. I bring over 20 years of combined experience in nursing, end-of-life support, and psychosocial work, with a particular passion for supporting individuals who have lived through trauma, chronic and progressive illness. I have a special interest in complex trauma (CPTSD), grief and loss, burnout, chronic and progressive illness, and recovery from high-pressure caring roles. I also provide training in Trauma-Informed Care and Vicarious Trauma for NDIS providers and frontline teams.

trudycahill.name: Trudy Cahill

trudycahill.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: LGBTIQA+, Trauma.

victoriacaplan.name: Victoria Caplan
victoriacaplan.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
victoriacaplan.description: Vicky at Comfort Counselling provides a safe, confidential and non-judgemental space providing support for people seeking specialised counselling focusing on Grief, Loss & Bereavement. Grief including special needs children, trauma, family estrangement, pet loss, immigration, unemployment and more.

vinaynair.name: Vinay Nair
vinaynair.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
vinaynair.description: Vinay Nair is a skilled counsellor who has been in the field for more than 15 years. He holds a deep understanding of the challenges individuals face across all age groups and life stages. His passion for counselling stems from his own life experiences and a strong belief in the importance of providing a hopeful and enriching environment for clients.

vincentviggiano.name: Vincent Viggiano
vincentviggiano.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
vincentviggiano.description: Vincent is a highly experienced counsellor and has completed a Masters in Counselling at Victoria University. He has over 17 years experience in the field of mental health and supporting individuals facing various psychological challenges. Throughout his career, Vincent has demonstrated a commitment to helping individuals overcome anxiety, depression and a wide range of mental health presentations, empowering them to lead healthier and more fulfilling lives.

yuhongzhao.name: Yuhong Zhao
yuhongzhao.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
yuhongzhao.description: Hi, I'm Yuhong Zhao, a registered counsellor with background in both Psychology and Counselling. I am an online counsellor who primarily works from an Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) perspective. I'm also good at working with trauma and CPTSD-related difficulties, including long-standing emotional distress, self-criticism, relationship difficulties, and responses shaped by negative past experiences.

zoltanalmady.name: Zoltan Almady
zoltanalmady.title: Counsellor (ACA Level 3)
zoltanalmady.description: Areas listed on ACA profile: LGBTIQA+, Trauma.

lanasciberras.name: Lana Sciberras
lanasciberras.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
lanasciberras.description: I am a Clinical Psychotherapist initially trained in Gestalt psychotherapy and mindfulness with a Process-oriented psychological approach (Processwork). My work is always in collaboration with my clients exploring at depth their process of change in a way that assists an emerging self that is both healing and strengthening, resulting in new ways to be in relationship with self, others and life. I use a compassionate approach that includes my training in Self-compassion therapy and Compassion Focused Therapy.
lanasciberras.specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

michelledate.name: Michelle Date
michelledate.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)

aichabrogan.name: Aicha Brogan
aichabrogan.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
aichabrogan.description: Aicha is a Somatic Psychotherapist trained in Gestalt Psychotherapy, Somatic Experiencing (SE) and EMDR with a Masters in Counselling. She uses regulating touch work for early trauma and integrates somatic, mindfulness, attachment and trauma-informed approaches into her work.
aichabrogan.specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing

shivonbarresi.name: Shivon Barresi
shivonbarresi.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
shivonbarresi.description: Shivon is a qualified and experienced Clinical Counsellor with a child and adolescent specialisation. She is also a Registered Clinical Family Therapist with the Australian Association of Family Therapy. She has a broad range of experience in providing support to children, adolescents, young people, and families in various contexts such as education, community health services, and private practice.
shivonbarresi.specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

paulablaz.name: Paula Blazé
paulablaz.title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
paulablaz.description: Relational Gestalt Psychotherapist (SEP) Somatic Experiencing Practitioner Trauma Specialist
paulablaz.specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy

juliagarami.name: Dr Julia Garami
juliagarami.title: Clinical Psychologist
juliagarami.description: I am passionate about helping clients turn emotional challenges into emotional growth by combining a warm approach with evidence-based therapy. I believe that everyone has inner strengths and resources to overcome challenges and has the potential to live a rich and meaningful life. I work with adults and young people experiencing anxiety, depression, trauma, child behavioural issues and oppositional behaviour, self-harm, suicidal ideation, obsessive compulsive symptoms, low-self esteem and life setbacks. I use a number of approaches, including cognitive behavioural therapy and acceptance and commitment therapy, Internal Family Systems Therapy and EMDR.
juliagarami.specialties: Diverse sexualities, Sexual abuse, Diverse genders, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), EMDR

danielwraith-franck.name: Daniel Wraith-Franck
danielwraith-franck.title: Psychologist
danielwraith-franck.description: I'm Daniel, a registered clinical psychologist with a deep curiosity about people's inner worlds, histories, and relationships. I aim to create a space that feels emotionally safe – free from assumptions, judgment, or pressure. My work is grounded in trauma-informed, evidence-based approaches such as Internal Family Systems (IFS) and Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR). I've been shaped by mentors I deeply respect, and over time, I've developed a process of gently weaving relations – between parts of ourselves, our past and present, and our relationships. I've supported people through anxiety, depression, trauma, grief, shame and obsessions – across diverse settings, including First Nations, migrant, and Western communities.
danielwraith-franck.specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Dissociative Identity Disorder, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Diverse genders, Partners/families of sex offenders, EMDR

jacquelinebaulch.name: Dr Jacqueline Baulch
jacquelinebaulch.title: Psychologist
jacquelinebaulch.description: My name is Dr Jacqueline Baulch and I am the Director of Inner Melbourne Clinical Psychology. I am a clinical psychologist who has worked with clients since 2008. Here are some of the areas we can help you with: - Anxiety - Depression - Stress & burnout - Trauma & emotional difficulties - Couples counselling - Individual relationship issues - Eating & body image concerns - Life changes - Personal growth & wellbeing - ADHD and autism
jacquelinebaulch.specialties: Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Diverse genders, Gender Dysphoria, EMDR, Schema Therapy

katherinewhite.name: Kathryn White
katherinewhite.title: Psychologist
katherinewhite.description: Friendly and professional, experienced in health and general psychology. Low-income rates available on request.
katherinewhite.specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Diverse genders, Diverse sexualities

elizabethshort.name: Dr Elizabeth Short
elizabethshort.title: Psychologist
elizabethshort.description: Dr Elizabeth Short is a clinical and community psychologist with over 30 years experience, assisting people who've experienced loss, discrimination, and/or trauma, and with the full range of issues. With Medicare, she is a provider of services in relation to pregnancy, birth, and early parenting. She works with people from diverse cultures and backgrounds, including refugee, Indigenous, and LGBTQIA+. Her approach is attachment-aware, trauma-informed, systemic, strengths-based, and respectful.
elizabethshort.specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse genders, Sexual abuse, Diverse sexualities, Schema Therapy

tahliafoley.name: Tahlia Foley
tahliafoley.title: Contact Psychologist
tahliafoley.description: I have over a decade of experience working with young people and adults across a variety of settings. I have experience supporting children, adolescents and adults through transitions, as well as knowledge of assessment and counselling approaches for common mental health conditions. I use a range of therapeutic approaches based upon the needs of the individual, including Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT), Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) and Schema Therapy.

daniellewilliamson.name: Dr Danielle Williamson
daniellewilliamson.title: Psychologist
daniellewilliamson.description: Danielle is a registered clinical psychologist who works with adults from diverse age groups, cultural backgrounds, and sexual orientation. Danielle has a particular interest in psychoanalytic psychotherapy. This form of treatment can be effective for a wide range of presenting concerns, including grief and bereavement, trauma, anxiety, depression, relationship issues, sexuality, life transitions and changes, and identity concerns.
daniellewilliamson.specialties: Diverse sexualities, Sexual abuse, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Diverse genders

rubyshirrefs.name: Ruby Shirrefs
rubyshirrefs.title: Clinical Psychologist
rubyshirrefs.description: I am a registered Clinical Psychologist with Masters level training in Clinical Psychology. My clinical experience is with individuals and families across the lifespan in private, inpatient, and community settings. I work with individuals experiencing a broad range of issues, but particularly with mood and anxiety disorders, PTSD and trauma-related disorders, and health-related concerns.
rubyshirrefs.specialties: Diverse genders, Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), EMDR, Schema Therapy

jonathankettle.name: Dr Jonathan Kettle
jonathankettle.title: Psychologist
jonathankettle.description: Previously the Head of Clinical Practice at The Cairnmillar Institute, I am a clinical psychologist with expertise in depression, anxiety, trauma, abuse, post-traumatic stress, relationships, substance use, ADHD & ASD, and gender & sexuality issues. I work with adults, adolescents and couples, and am also a senior lecturer at The Cairnmillar Institute.
jonathankettle.specialties: Diverse genders, Gender Dysphoria, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual abuse, Diverse sexualities, Sexual difficulties

andrewstlawrence.name: Andrew St Lawrence
andrewstlawrence.title: Contact Psychologist
andrewstlawrence.description: My curious and authentic approach is focused around helping people make sense of their problems, and regain a sense of control over their life. While I support people in feeling better, I prioritise working together to build lasting wellbeing. I work with a range of people with various forms of suffering, from anxiety and depression, to PTSD, phobias, disordered eating, complex trauma, and adjustment to life transitions.
andrewstlawrence.specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Diverse genders, Sexual abuse, Diverse sexualities

tysonsharpe.name: Tyson Sharpe
tysonsharpe.title: Psychologist
tysonsharpe.description: I work with adults who want to better understand their experiences, develop practical ways of coping and make changes that support a more manageable and meaningful life. I am a registered psychologist with experience across private practice, corporate mental health, psychiatry, traumatic injuries, persistent pain and crisis support. I provide trauma-informed, neuroaffirming and gender-affirming care.
tysonsharpe.specialties: Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Diverse genders, EMDR, Schema Therapy

jordanwhitehead.name: Jordan Whitehead
jordanwhitehead.title: Psychologist
jordanwhitehead.description: Jordan Whitehead helps people find steadiness and meaning through life's most challenging transitions. She has over 15 years of experience across public health and private practice as a Registered Psychologist.
jordanwhitehead.specialties: Diverse genders, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sexual difficulties, Diverse sexualities

anagalbanleon.name: Ana Galban Leon
anagalbanleon.title: Contact Psychologist
anagalbanleon.description: Do you find yourself overthinking, feeling guilty when you try to set boundaries, or caught in repeating patterns that leave you feeling drained and burnt out? I work with young women who are highly self-aware, yet still find it hard to break out of these cycles. I take a holistic, person-centered approach that combines the mind-body connection with various evidence-based modalities, including EMDR for trauma and Internal Family Systems-informed.
anagalbanleon.specialties: Diverse genders, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Diverse sexualities, EMDR

tasia-parismanuel.name: Tasia-Paris Manuel
tasia-parismanuel.title: Contact Psychologist
tasia-parismanuel.description: Hello, my name is Tasia (she/her). I am a Psychologist and I help adults who are navigating the impact of intergenerational trauma, complex family dynamics, and identity struggles to reconnect with their authentic selves and build more meaningful, empowered relationships - with others and with themselves.
tasia-parismanuel.specialties: Diverse sexualities, Sexual abuse, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Gender Dysphoria, Sexual difficulties, Diverse genders, Sex worker issues, Schema Therapy

jodiecicaji.name: Jodie Cicaji
jodiecicaji.title: Psychologist
jodiecicaji.description: Jodie is a warm, supportive and experienced psychologist who provides a non-judgmental therapeutic space to help clients to build insight, clarity and to find solutions within themselves. She has experience working with a range of issues and mental health conditions including anxiety, depression, PTSD & C-PTSD, adjustment difficulties, study & work stress, attachment & interpersonal difficulties. Clients who are interested in practical, in-depth or experiential approaches (such as Schema Therapy & mindfulness work) may especially find working with Jodie to be a good fit.
jodiecicaji.specialties: Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Diverse genders, Schema Therapy

michaelcurrie.name: Dr Michael Currie
michaelcurrie.title: Psychologist
michaelcurrie.description: I have treated adults, adolescents and children for over 30 years. My approach is psychoanalytically – oriented.
michaelcurrie.specialties: Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Sexual abuse, Diverse genders, Gender Dysphoria, Sexual difficulties, Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Sex worker issues

carmenbeaumont.name: Carmen Beaumont
carmenbeaumont.title: Psychologist
carmenbeaumont.description: I have been practicing as a counsellor since 2001 and obtained my Full Psychologist Registration in 2003. Since then I have worked in employment agencies, Hospital settings and Private Practice.
carmenbeaumont.specialties: Diverse genders, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Diverse sexualities

jacquelinemunoz.name: Jacqueline Munoz
jacquelinemunoz.title: Clinical Psychologist
jacquelinemunoz.description: Jacqueline is a senior clinical psychologist based in Parkville, Victoria, with over a decade experience in psychological assessment, treatment, clinical supervision, and professional consultation services. At Embrace Trauma Therapy, I offer evidence-based, compassionate mental health care for people navigating mental health concerns, past trauma, and periods of overwhelm or transition. My work is grounded in trauma-informed, relational, and integrative approaches to therapy. This includes drawing from somatic and nervous system – focused frameworks, alongside evidence-based psychological therapies, such as EMDR, IFS and other parts-work frameworks, and mindfulness practices.
